source.text: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל חַנָּה֙ וַתֹּאמַ֔ר עָלַ֤ץ לִבִּי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה רָ֥מָה קַרְנִ֖י בַּֽיהוָ֑ה רָ֤חַב פִּי֙ עַל־א֣וֹיְבַ֔י כִּ֥י שָׂמַ֖חְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And prayed Hannah and said, exults my heart in Yahweh; is lifted high my horn in Yahweh; is wide my mouth over my enemies, for I rejoice in your salvation.

en.L: And Hannah prayed and said, \q "My heart exults in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q my horn is lifted high in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q My mouth is wide over my enemies, \q for I rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: Then Hannah prayed, and she said: \q "My heart is glad in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my horn is raised high. \q I boast loudly over my enemies, \q because I rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.R: Then Hannah prayed: \q "My heart is full of joy because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made me strong. \q Now I can laugh at my enemies, \q because I rejoice that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have saved me.

es.L: Y Ana oró y dijo: \q «Mi corazón salta de júbilo en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q mi cuerno se alza en lo alto en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Mi boca se abre ancha contra mis enemigos, \q porque me gozo en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: Entonces Ana oró y dijo: \q «Mi corazón se alegra en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mi cuerno se levanta en alto. \q Alzo la voz con orgullo contra mis enemigos, \q porque me gozo en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.R: Entonces Ana oró así: \q «Mi corazón está lleno de alegría por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha hecho fuerte. \q Ahora puedo reírme de mis enemigos, \q porque me alegra que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hayas salvado.

fr.L: Et Anne pria et dit : \q « Mon cœur exulte en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q ma corne est élevée en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Ma bouche s’ouvre grande contre mes ennemis, \q car je me réjouis de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Alors Anne pria, et elle dit : \q « Mon cœur se réjouit en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ma force est relevée. \q Je peux crier bien haut contre mes ennemis, \q car je me réjouis de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.R: Alors Anne a prié : \q « Mon cœur est plein de joie à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a rendue forte. \q Maintenant, je peux rire de mes ennemis, \q car je suis heureuse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’aies sauvée.

sw.L: Na Hana akaomba, akasema, \q "Moyo wangu unashangilia ndani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q pembe yangu imeinuliwa juu ndani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Kinywa changu kimepanuka juu ya adui zangu, \q kwa maana ninafurahi katika wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Kisha Hana akaomba, akasema: \q "Moyo wangu unafurahi ndani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q ndani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} pembe yangu imeinuliwa juu. \q Ninajivuna kwa sauti juu ya adui zangu, \q kwa sababu ninashangilia wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Kisha Hana akaomba: \q "Moyo wangu umejaa furaha kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenitia nguvu. \q Sasa ninaweza kuwacheka adui zangu, \q kwa sababu ninafurahi kwamba umeniokoa.

vi.L: An-ne cầu nguyện và nói: \q "Lòng tôi hớn hở trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q sừng tôi được ngẩng cao trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Miệng tôi mở rộng trên kẻ thù tôi, \q vì tôi vui mừng trong sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Rồi An-ne cầu nguyện rằng: \q "Lòng tôi mừng rỡ trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sừng tôi được ngẩng cao. \q Tôi lớn tiếng đắc thắng trên kẻ thù, \q vì tôi vui mừng trong sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi An-ne cầu nguyện: \q "Lòng tôi tràn ngập niềm vui vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ. \q Giờ đây tôi có thể cười vào mặt kẻ thù, \q vì tôi vui mừng được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu giúp.

ko.L: 그리고 한나가 기도하며 말했다. \q "내 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 기뻐 뛰고, \q 내 뿔이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 높이 들렸다. \q 내 입이 내 원수들 위로 크게 열렸다. \q 제가 주님의 구원을 기뻐하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그때 한나가 기도하며 말했다. \q "내 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 인해 기뻐하고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 뿔을 높이 드셨다. \q 이제 내가 원수들 앞에서 큰소리친다. \q 제가 주님의 구원을 기뻐하기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그러자 한나가 기도했다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문에 내 마음이 기쁨으로 가득하다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 강하게 하셨다. \q 이제 나는 원수들을 비웃을 수 있다. \q 주님께서 저를 구하셨으니 제가 기뻐합니다.

decisions.choice: prayed: Hannah's song is called a prayer
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for Hannah's pleading in 1:10-12 and 1:26-27. Prayer includes praise as well as request: the woman who prayed in tears now prays in thanks. Verses 1-10 are one poem, a song of praise.

decisions.choice: my horn is lifted high: my strength and honor are restored
decisions.reason: The horn of a wild ox stands for its strength and pride (Deuteronomy 33:17; Psalm 92:11). A lifted horn is a picture of someone raised from shame to dignity. Hannah had been mocked for having no children (1:6-7). The poem ends with the same picture for the king (verse 10).

decisions.choice: my mouth is wide over my enemies: I can speak out, even laugh, against those who mocked me
decisions.reason: An open mouth is a picture of boasting or mocking (Psalm 35:21; Isaiah 57:4). Hannah, silenced by her rival's taunts, can now answer them. The enemies are left unnamed, so the song speaks for anyone God has rescued.

decisions.choice: your salvation: the rescue God has given
decisions.reason: The noun means deliverance, help that saves someone from a trouble they cannot escape. Here it is the gift of a son after years of barrenness; the song widens it to God's rescue of the poor and his people (verses 8-10).

decisions.choice: Mary's song in Luke 1:46-55 echoes Hannah's song
decisions.reason: Mary, another woman given a son by God, begins as Hannah does, rejoicing in God her Savior (Luke 1:46-47). Her song takes up Hannah's themes: God lifts the lowly, brings down the proud, fills the hungry and sends the rich away empty (verses 4-8; Luke 1:51-53), and raises a horn of salvation for his anointed king (verse 10; Luke 1:69).

decisions.choice: I boast loudly over (Balanced); I can laugh at (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the open mouth. Balanced says what it means, and Readable puts it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made me strong (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the horn, which returns in verse 10. Readable states the sense and names the LORD as the one who raised her, as the parallel line implies.

decisions.choice: a double quotation mark opens here and closes at the end of verse 10
decisions.reason: The whole poem is Hannah's prayer, so it is set as one quotation. The first line, the narrator's introduction, stands as its own line before the poem begins.

decisions.choice: the song set in lines at every level, as the English, with « opening here and » closing at the end of verse 10
decisions.reason: Hannah's song is poetry; French follows the English line breaks, which follow the Hebrew's division, and keeps one quotation for the whole song.

decisions.choice: "ma force est relevée"
decisions.reason: The horn stands for strength and honor (m2). In French "corne" says nothing of strength and can raise a smile, so Balanced says what it means, as the English Readable does; Literal keeps "ma corne".

decisions.choice: pembe yangu imeinuliwa (L, B); amenitia nguvu (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the horn, the Hebrew picture of strength and honour (m2), as the English does; Readable says what it means. The song is set in lines at every level, as the English is.

decisions.choice: wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}
decisions.reason: The possessive addressed to God is a free pronoun and takes the span. At Readable "umeniokoa" carries "you" inside the verb, which cannot take a capital, so Readable has no span there.

decisions.choice: the song set in lines at every level, with Vietnamese breaks following the Hebrew's division; Hannah says "tôi" and speaks to God as "Ngài"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: lines follow the English record. The song is a prayer, so Hannah uses the psalmist's forms of the Vietnamese style guide (section 7a).

decisions.choice: "sừng tôi được ngẩng cao" (L, B); "đã làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ" (R)
decisions.reason: The horn is strength and honor restored (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, which the Vietnamese Psalms also keep, and Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The song speaks about God in the plain style with the honorific and turns to God in the formal polite style (합쇼체) where the Hebrew says "your salvation" and "besides you" (verse 2)
alternatives: the plain style throughout, with "주의" for "your"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note for Korean: the speech level follows the Hebrew's turns between speaking about God and speaking to God, as the published Psalm 18. The quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 10.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 강하게 하셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The horn is strength and honor (m2); Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does. Literal and Balanced keep the horn.

source.text: אֵין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: There is none holy like Yahweh, for there is none besides you; and there is no rock like our God.

en.L: There is none holy like {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for there is none besides {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q and there is no rock like our God.
en.B: No one is holy like {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q indeed, there is none but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and no rock is like our God.
en.R: No one is holy like {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q There is no one but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q No rock keeps us as safe as our God.

es.L: No hay santo como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque no hay nadie fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q y no hay roca como nuestro Dios.
es.B: Nadie es santo como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q en verdad, no hay otro sino {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, \q y no hay roca como nuestro Dios.
es.R: Nadie es santo como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q No hay nadie más que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. \q Ninguna roca nos protege como nuestro Dios.

fr.L: Il n’y a pas de saint comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car il n’y a personne en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q et il n’y a pas de rocher comme notre Dieu.
fr.B: Personne n’est saint comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q oui, il n’y a personne d’autre que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q et aucun rocher n’est comme notre Dieu.
fr.R: Personne n’est saint comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Il n’y a personne d’autre que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Aucun rocher ne nous protège aussi bien que notre Dieu.

sw.L: Hakuna aliye mtakatifu kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana hakuna mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; \q wala hakuna mwamba kama Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Hakuna aliye mtakatifu kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q hakika, hakuna mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q wala hakuna mwamba ulio kama Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Hakuna aliye mtakatifu kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Hakuna mwingine ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Hakuna mwamba unaotulinda salama kama Mungu wetu.

vi.L: Không có ai thánh như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì không có ai ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q và không có vầng đá nào như Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Không ai thánh như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q thật vậy, chẳng có ai ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q chẳng có vầng đá nào như Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.R: Không ai thánh như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Chẳng có ai ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Không vầng đá nào che chở chúng ta an toàn như Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}처럼 거룩한 이가 없으니, \q 주님 외에는 아무도 없습니다. \q 우리 하나님 같은 반석도 없다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}처럼 거룩한 분은 없다. \q 참으로 주님밖에 없습니다. \q 우리 하나님 같은 반석은 없다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}처럼 거룩한 분은 아무도 없다. \q 주님 말고는 아무도 없습니다. \q 우리 하나님만큼 우리를 안전하게 지켜 주는 바위는 없다.

decisions.choice: holy: set apart, unlike anyone or anything else
decisions.reason: Holiness is God's otherness: he is in a class of his own (Exodus 15:11). The verse says it three ways: no one is holy like him, there is no one besides him, no rock is like him.

decisions.choice: besides you: the song turns to speak to God directly
decisions.reason: For one line Hannah addresses God ("you"), then speaks about him again ("our God"). Such shifts are common in Hebrew praise (Psalm 23:4-5).

decisions.choice: rock: God as a sure place of safety
decisions.reason: A rock is a high, firm place where someone can find shelter from attack. Scripture often calls God a rock (Deuteronomy 32:4, 31; 2 Samuel 22:2-3, 32; Psalm 18:3).

decisions.choice: No rock keeps us as safe as our God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the rock means: protection and safety.

source.text: אַל־תַּרְבּ֤וּ תְדַבְּרוּ֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה יֵצֵ֥א עָתָ֖ק מִפִּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל דֵּעוֹת֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְל֥וֹ נִתְכְּנ֖וּ עֲלִלֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not multiply, you speak proud, proud; [let not] go out arrogance from your mouth; for a God of knowledge [is] Yahweh, and by him are weighed deeds.

en.L: Do not keep on speaking proudly, so proudly; \q [let not] arrogance come out of your mouth; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] a God of knowledge, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} deeds are weighed.
en.B: Do not keep talking so proudly, \q or let arrogant words leave your lips, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a God who knows all things, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} every action is weighed.
en.R: Stop all your proud talk! \q Do not say such arrogant things! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is a God who knows everything, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges everything people do.

es.L: No {{plural_you:multipliquen|multipliquéis}} palabras altivas, tan altivas; \q [que no] salga arrogancia de {{plural_you:su boca|vuestra boca}}; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] un Dios de conocimiento, \q y por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} son pesadas las acciones.
es.B: No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} hablando con tanta soberbia, \q ni {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} salir palabras arrogantes de {{plural_you:sus labios|vuestros labios}}, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios que todo lo sabe, \q y por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es pesada toda acción.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hablar con tanto orgullo! \q ¡No {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} cosas tan arrogantes! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios que lo sabe todo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzga todo lo que hace la gente.

fr.L: Ne multipliez pas les paroles hautaines, si hautaines ; \q [que] l’arrogance [ne] sorte [pas] de votre bouche ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] un Dieu de connaissance, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} les actions sont pesées.
fr.B: Cessez de parler avec tant d’orgueil, \q que des paroles arrogantes ne sortent plus de vos lèvres, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un Dieu qui sait tout, \q et c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui pèse chaque action.
fr.R: Arrêtez de parler avec orgueil ! \q Ne dites plus ces paroles arrogantes ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un Dieu qui sait tout, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge tout ce que font les gens.

sw.L: Msiendelee kusema kwa kiburi, kwa kiburi kingi hivyo; \q [usitoke] ufidhuli katika vinywa vyenu; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] Mungu wa maarifa, \q na kwake matendo hupimwa.
sw.B: Msiendelee kusema kwa majivuno hivyo, \q wala maneno ya kiburi yasitoke midomoni mwenu, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu ajuaye mambo yote, \q naye hupima kila tendo.
sw.R: Acheni maneno yenu yote ya kiburi! \q Msiseme mambo ya majivuno! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu anayejua kila kitu, \q naye huhukumu kila kitu wanachofanya watu.

vi.L: Đừng cứ nói những lời kiêu ngạo, quá kiêu ngạo; \q [đừng để] lời ngạo mạn ra khỏi miệng các người; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của tri thức, \q và bởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} các việc làm được cân nhắc.
vi.B: Đừng nói những lời kiêu căng mãi nữa, \q đừng để lời ngạo mạn ra khỏi môi các người, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời biết mọi sự, \q và mọi việc làm đều được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cân nhắc.
vi.R: Hãy thôi nói những lời kiêu căng! \q Đừng nói những lời ngạo mạn như thế! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời biết hết mọi điều, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử mọi việc người ta làm.

ko.L: 너희는 교만하게, 교만하게 말하기를 계속하지 마라. \q 오만함이 너희 입에서 나오지 [않게 하여라]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 지식의 하나님이시니, \q 행위들이 그분에 의해 달아진다.
ko.B: 너희는 그렇게 교만하게 말하지 말고, \q 오만한 말을 입 밖에 내지 마라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 모든 것을 아시는 하나님이시니, \q 그분께서 모든 행위를 달아 보신다.
ko.R: 교만한 말을 그만두어라! \q 거만한 말을 하지 마라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 모든 것을 아시는 하나님이시다. \q 그분께서 사람들이 하는 모든 일을 판단하신다.

decisions.choice: do not keep talking proudly, so proudly: a warning to the arrogant
decisions.reason: The commands are plural, spoken to the proud in general. The word "proud" is repeated for emphasis. Behind it stands Hannah's rival, who taunted her year after year (1:6-7), but the song does not name her.

decisions.choice: and by him deeds are weighed, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The reading the scribes marked (qere) is lo, "by him": God weighs what people do. The written consonants (ketiv) have the word that sounds the same but means "not", which would give "and deeds are not weighed" or, as a question, "are deeds not weighed?" Both say that God judges, but the marked reading says it plainly.

decisions.choice: a God of knowledge: a God who knows fully
decisions.reason: The noun is plural, which stresses how complete his knowledge is. Nothing that the proud say or do escapes him.

decisions.choice: weighed: tested and judged
decisions.reason: God is pictured as weighing deeds on scales to find their true worth (Proverbs 16:2; 21:2; 24:12).

decisions.choice: a God who knows all things (Balanced); a God who knows everything (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "God of knowledge" means.

decisions.choice: ustedes forms by default ("multipliquen", "su boca"); vosotros forms with the plural-you setting ("multipliquéis", "vuestra boca")
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as in the Pentateuch and Psalms: wherever a group is addressed, Spanish must choose a plural form of address. The default is the "ustedes" form used by most Spanish speakers; the plural-you setting gives the "vosotros" form of Spain. The span covers each verb, pronoun or possessive phrase that changes. Here Hannah turns to the proud as a group.

decisions.choice: msiendelee, vinywa vyenu (plural)
decisions.reason: The warning is spoken to the proud as a group, so Swahili, which must choose, uses the plural "ninyi" forms, as the English "you" is read.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the proud whom the song warns
decisions.reason: The warning is spoken to a group, not to one rival by name; "các người" is a firm address without the contempt of "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: The warning to the proud is in the plain style with "너희"
decisions.reason: Hannah turns to the arrogant, as a psalmist to his enemies; the plain style keeps the force of the command.

source.text: קֶ֥שֶׁת גִּבֹּרִ֖ים חַתִּ֑ים וְנִכְשָׁלִ֖ים אָ֥זְרוּ חָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] bow of mighty [ones] [are] shattered, and stumbling [ones] gird on strength.

en.L: [The] bow of [the] mighty [are] shattered, \q and [those who] stumble gird on strength.
en.B: The bows of the mighty are broken, \q while those who stumbled are armed with strength.
en.R: The bows of strong soldiers are broken, \q but people who were weak are made strong.

es.L: El arco de los poderosos [es] destrozado, \q y los que tropiezan se ciñen de fuerza.
es.B: Los arcos de los poderosos se quiebran, \q mientras que los que tropezaban se arman de fuerza.
es.R: Los arcos de los soldados fuertes se rompen, \q pero los débiles reciben fuerza.

fr.L: L’arc des puissants [est] brisé, \q et [ceux qui] chancelaient se ceignent de force.
fr.B: Les arcs des guerriers sont brisés, \q tandis que ceux qui chancelaient sont armés de force.
fr.R: Les arcs des soldats puissants sont brisés, \q mais les faibles sont rendus forts.

sw.L: Upinde wa mashujaa umevunjika, \q na [wale] wanaojikwaa wamejifunga nguvu.
sw.B: Pinde za mashujaa zimevunjwa, \q na wale waliojikwaa wamevikwa nguvu.
sw.R: Pinde za askari wenye nguvu zimevunjika, \q lakini watu waliokuwa dhaifu wamefanywa kuwa na nguvu.

vi.L: Cung của [những kẻ] mạnh bị gãy, \q còn [những người] vấp ngã thì được thắt lưng bằng sức mạnh.
vi.B: Cung của những kẻ mạnh bị bẻ gãy, \q còn những người vấp ngã được trang bị sức mạnh.
vi.R: Cung của những chiến binh mạnh mẽ bị gãy, \q còn những người yếu đuối lại được làm cho mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: 용사들의 활이 꺾이고, \q 비틀거리는 자들은 힘으로 띠를 띤다.
ko.B: 용사들의 활은 꺾이고, \q 넘어지던 자들은 힘으로 무장한다.
ko.R: 힘센 군인들의 활은 부러지고, \q 약하던 사람들은 강해진다.

decisions.choice: God turns things upside down: the strong are broken and the weak made strong
decisions.reason: Verses 4-8 list reversals of human fortune. The poem does not name who acts in verses 4-5, but verses 6-8 say it is the LORD. Mary's song takes up the theme (Luke 1:51-53).

decisions.choice: the bow of the mighty are shattered: the warriors are broken along with their weapons
decisions.reason: The verb "shattered" is plural and agrees with "the mighty" rather than with "bow", so the line speaks of the soldiers themselves as well as their bows.

decisions.choice: gird on strength: are made strong, ready to act
decisions.reason: A belt was tightened around the waist before work or battle. To be girded with strength is to be equipped for action (2 Samuel 22:40; Psalm 18:33).

decisions.choice: are armed with strength (Balanced); are made strong (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "gird on". Balanced uses a natural picture of being equipped; Readable states the sense.

source.text: שְׂבֵעִ֤ים בַּלֶּ֨חֶם֙ נִשְׂכָּ֔רוּ וּרְעֵבִ֖ים חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְרַבַּ֥ת בָּנִ֖ים אֻמְלָֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] full for bread hire themselves out, and [the] hungry cease; until barren bears seven, and many of sons languishes.

en.L: [The] full hire themselves out for bread, \q and [the] hungry cease [to hunger]; \q even [the] barren bears seven, \q and [she who has] many sons wastes away.
en.B: Those who were full hire themselves out for bread, \q but the hungry hunger no more. \q The childless woman gives birth to seven, \q but the mother of many sons pines away.
en.R: People who had plenty to eat now work for food, \q but hungry people now have enough. \q The woman who could not have children has seven, \q but the woman with many sons becomes weak and sad.

es.L: Los saciados se alquilan por pan, \q y los hambrientos dejan [de tener hambre]; \q hasta la estéril da a luz siete, \q y la [que tiene] muchos hijos languidece.
es.B: Los que estaban saciados se contratan por un pedazo de pan, \q pero los hambrientos ya no pasan hambre. \q La mujer sin hijos da a luz siete, \q pero la madre de muchos hijos se marchita.
es.R: Los que tenían comida de sobra ahora trabajan para poder comer, \q pero los que pasaban hambre ahora tienen suficiente. \q La mujer que no podía tener hijos tiene siete, \q pero la que tenía muchos hijos se queda débil y triste.

fr.L: [Ceux qui étaient] rassasiés se louent pour du pain, \q et [ceux qui étaient] affamés cessent [d’avoir faim] ; \q même la stérile enfante sept [fois], \q et [celle qui avait] beaucoup de fils dépérit.
fr.B: Ceux qui étaient rassasiés se louent pour avoir du pain, \q mais les affamés n’ont plus faim. \q La femme stérile met au monde sept enfants, \q mais la mère de nombreux fils se flétrit.
fr.R: Ceux qui avaient beaucoup à manger travaillent maintenant pour se nourrir, \q mais ceux qui avaient faim ont maintenant assez. \q La femme qui ne pouvait pas avoir d’enfants en a sept, \q mais celle qui avait beaucoup de fils devient faible et triste.

sw.L: [Wale] walioshiba wamejiajiri kwa ajili ya mkate, \q na [wale] wenye njaa wamekoma [kuona njaa]; \q hata [yule] tasa amezaa saba, \q na [yule mwenye] wana wengi amedhoofika.
sw.B: Wale waliokuwa wameshiba wanajiajiri kwa ajili ya mkate, \q lakini wenye njaa hawaoni njaa tena. \q Mwanamke asiye na watoto anazaa saba, \q lakini mama wa wana wengi anafifia.
sw.R: Watu waliokuwa na chakula tele sasa wanafanya kazi ili wapate chakula, \q lakini watu waliokuwa na njaa sasa wana chakula cha kutosha. \q Mwanamke aliyeshindwa kupata watoto ana saba, \q lakini mwanamke mwenye wana wengi anakuwa dhaifu na mwenye huzuni.

vi.L: [Những kẻ] no nê phải làm thuê để có bánh, \q còn [những kẻ] đói thì thôi [đói]; \q ngay cả [người] son sẻ sinh bảy [con], \q còn [người có] nhiều con trai thì tàn héo.
vi.B: Những người từng no đủ phải đi làm thuê kiếm bánh, \q còn những người đói khát thì không còn đói nữa. \q Người đàn bà hiếm muộn sinh được bảy con, \q còn người mẹ đông con trai lại héo hon.
vi.R: Những người từng có dư thức ăn nay phải làm thuê để có cái ăn, \q còn những người đói nay được ăn no. \q Người đàn bà không thể có con nay có bảy đứa, \q còn người đàn bà có nhiều con trai lại trở nên yếu ớt và buồn bã.

ko.L: 배부르던 자들은 빵을 위해 품을 팔고, \q 굶주리던 자들은 [굶주림을] 그친다. \q 아이를 못 낳던 여자는 일곱을 낳고, \q 아들이 많던 여자는 쇠약해진다.
ko.B: 배부르던 자들은 빵을 얻으려고 품을 팔고, \q 굶주리던 자들은 더 이상 굶주리지 않는다. \q 자식 없던 여자는 일곱을 낳고, \q 아들 많던 어머니는 시들어 간다.
ko.R: 먹을 것이 넉넉하던 사람들이 이제는 먹고살려고 일하고, \q 굶주리던 사람들은 이제 배불리 먹는다. \q 아이를 낳지 못하던 여자는 일곱 자녀를 두고, \q 아들이 많던 여자는 약해지고 슬퍼한다.

decisions.choice: the hungry cease: they hunger no more
alternatives: the hungry rest from their labor
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "stop" or "cease", and the sense is that they stop being hungry. Some take it from a rare word meaning "grow fat", which gives the same picture: the hungry now have plenty.

decisions.choice: until, even: the line moves to the most striking reversal of all
alternatives: the hungry hunger no more forever
decisions.reason: The small word usually means "until" or "up to". Here it introduces the next line: it goes as far as this, that the barren woman bears seven. Others join it to the line before and read a similar word meaning "forever": "the hungry cease from hunger forever".

decisions.choice: seven: a full, complete family
decisions.reason: Seven is the number of completeness (Ruth 4:15, "better to you than seven sons"). Hannah later bore five more children (2:21), not seven; the number is a picture, not a count. The mother of many sons recalls her rival Peninnah (1:2).

decisions.choice: the full and the hungry change places
decisions.reason: Mary sings the same: "he has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich he has sent away with nothing" (Luke 1:53; compare Psalm 107:9).

decisions.choice: hunger no more (Balanced); now have enough (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies "to hunger" in brackets. Balanced and Readable say plainly what the hungry stop doing.

source.text: יְהוָ֖ה מֵמִ֣ית וּמְחַיֶּ֑ה מוֹרִ֥יד שְׁא֖וֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh kills and makes alive; brings down [to] Sheol and brings up.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} kills and makes alive; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings down [to] Sheol and brings up.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} brings death and gives life; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sends down to Sheol and brings up again.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} causes death and gives life. \q He sends people down to the grave, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings them back up.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} da muerte y da vida; \q hace descender al Seol y hace subir.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quita la vida y la da; \q hace bajar al lugar de los muertos y vuelve a hacer subir.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace morir y da la vida. \q Manda a la gente a la tumba, y la vuelve a sacar de allí.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait mourir et fait vivre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait descendre au Shéol et [en] fait remonter.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donne la mort et donne la vie ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait descendre au séjour des morts et en fait remonter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait mourir et donne la vie. \q Il fait descendre les gens au séjour des morts, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les en fait remonter.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huua na huhuisha; \q hushusha [hadi] Kuzimu na hupandisha.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huleta kifo na hutoa uzima; \q huwashusha Kuzimu na kuwapandisha tena.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huleta kifo na hutoa uhai. \q Huwapeleka watu chini kaburini, kisha huwarudisha juu tena.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giết chết và làm cho sống; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem xuống Âm Phủ và đem lên.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gây ra sự chết và ban sự sống; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho xuống Âm Phủ rồi lại đem lên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho chết và cho sống. \q Ngài đưa người ta xuống nơi của người chết, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại đem họ lên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 죽이기도 하시고 살리기도 하신다. \q 스올에 내려가게도 하시고 올라오게도 하신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 죽음을 내리기도 하시고 생명을 주기도 하신다. \q 스올로 내려보내기도 하시고 다시 올라오게도 하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 죽게도 하시고 살게도 하신다. \q 사람을 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳으로 내려보내기도 하시고, 다시 데리고 올라오기도 하신다.

decisions.choice: the LORD kills and makes alive: he alone rules over life and death
decisions.reason: The same words appear in the Song of Moses: "I put to death and I make alive" (Deuteronomy 32:39). In Hannah's life it means that the LORD who closed her womb (1:5-6) has given her a child.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the realm of the dead, below the earth. To bring someone down to it is to bring death; to bring someone up from it may mean rescuing a person from the brink of death (Psalm 30:4) or giving life back to the dead. The line keeps both open.

decisions.choice: the grave (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "Sheol". Readable says "the grave", the plain sense for new readers.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" (Literal); "le séjour des morts" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note settles. Readable keeps "le séjour des morts", plain enough in French, where the English Readable says "the grave"; "l’enfer" would bring in later ideas of punishment that the word does not have here (m2).

decisions.choice: "el Seol" (L); "el lugar de los muertos" (B); "la tumba" (R)
alternatives: "el Seol" at Balanced, as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Pentateuch and Psalms notes: Literal keeps the name; Balanced says what it is, since "Seol" means little to most Spanish readers; Readable says "la tumba", as the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: Kuzimu (L, B); kaburini (R)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note: Sheol is "Kuzimu", the Swahili place of the dead; Readable says "kaburi", as the English says "the grave". The Swahili verbs carry "he" inside them, so there are no deity pronoun spans in this verse.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R) for Sheol
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note and the Vietnamese Psalm 139:8; Readable names the place of the dead where the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: "스올" (L, B); "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Genesis and Psalms notes for Korean; "음부" is an older church word with other senses today. Used for the whole block.

source.text: יְהוָ֖ה מוֹרִ֣ישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁ֑יר מַשְׁפִּ֖יל אַף־מְרוֹמֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich; brings low, also lifts high.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} makes poor and makes rich; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings low, yes, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts high.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} makes some poor and others rich; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbles, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also exalts.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} makes some people poor and others rich. \q He brings some down and lifts others up.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} empobrece y enriquece; \q humilla, y también enaltece.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace pobres a unos y ricos a otros; \q a unos humilla y a otros enaltece.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hace que unos sean pobres y otros ricos. \q A unos los hace bajar y a otros los levanta.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appauvrit et enrichit ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} abaisse, et aussi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} élève.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rend les uns pauvres et les autres riches ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} humilie, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} élève aussi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rend certaines personnes pauvres et d’autres riches. \q Il fait descendre les uns et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} élève les autres.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hufukarisha na hutajirisha; \q hushusha chini, naam, huinua juu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwafanya wengine maskini na wengine matajiri; \q huwanyenyekeza, na pia huwakweza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwafanya watu wengine kuwa maskini na wengine matajiri. \q Huwashusha wengine na kuwainua wengine.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho nghèo và làm cho giàu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hạ xuống, phải, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nâng lên cao.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho người này nghèo, người kia giàu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hạ người xuống, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng nâng người lên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho người này nghèo, người kia giàu. \q Ngài hạ người này xuống và nâng người kia lên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 가난하게도 하시고 부하게도 하신다. \q 낮추기도 하시고, 참으로 높이기도 하신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어떤 이는 가난하게, 어떤 이는 부유하게 하신다. \q 낮추기도 하시고 높이기도 하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어떤 사람은 가난하게, 어떤 사람은 부자가 되게 하신다. \q 어떤 사람은 낮추시고 어떤 사람은 높이신다.

decisions.choice: makes poor, makes rich, brings low, lifts high: what the LORD does again and again
decisions.reason: The verbs are participles, describing God's ongoing way of acting rather than one event. The pairs of opposites say that every change of fortune is in his hands (Psalm 75:8).

decisions.choice: brings low and lifts high
decisions.reason: Mary sings, "He has pulled the mighty down from their thrones and raised up the lowly" (Luke 1:52).

decisions.choice: some ... others (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Hebrew does not name the objects. Balanced and Readable supply "some" and "others" so the English does not sound as if the same people are made both poor and rich at once.

source.text: מֵקִ֨ים מֵעָפָ֜ר דָּ֗ל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת֙ יָרִ֣ים אֶבְי֔וֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב֙ עִם־נְדִיבִ֔ים וְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד יַנְחִלֵ֑ם כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ מְצֻ֣קֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וַיָּ֥שֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תֵּבֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: raising from dust [the] poor, from [the] ash heap he lifts [the] needy, to make sit with nobles, and a throne of honor he makes them inherit; for to Yahweh [belong the] pillars of [the] earth, and he set on them [the] world.

en.L: He raises [the] poor from [the] dust; \q from [the] ash heap {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts [the] needy, \q to seat [them] with nobles, \q and a throne of honor {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them to inherit. \q For to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [belong the] pillars of [the] earth, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set the world on them.
en.B: He lifts the poor up out of the dust \q and raises those in need from the ash heap, \q to seat them with nobles \q and give them a throne of honor as their own. \q For the pillars of the earth belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q on them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set the world.
en.R: He lifts poor people out of the dirt. \q He raises needy people from the garbage heap. \q He seats them with princes and gives them places of honor. \q The foundations of the earth belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set the world on them.

es.L: Levanta del polvo al pobre; \q del montón de cenizas alza al necesitado, \q para sentar[los] con los nobles, \q y les da en herencia un trono de honor. \q Porque {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [son] las columnas de la tierra, \q y sobre ellas ha asentado el mundo.
es.B: Saca del polvo al pobre \q y levanta del basurero al necesitado, \q para sentarlos entre los nobles \q y darles en propiedad un trono de honor. \q Porque las columnas de la tierra son {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q sobre ellas ha asentado el mundo.
es.R: Saca a los pobres del polvo. \q Levanta a los necesitados del basurero. \q Los sienta con príncipes y les da lugares de honor. \q Los cimientos de la tierra son {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y sobre ellos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha puesto el mundo.

fr.L: Il relève le pauvre de la poussière ; \q du tas de cendres {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} élève l’indigent, \q pour [le] faire asseoir avec les nobles, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne en héritage un trône de gloire. \q Car {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} [sont] les piliers de la terre, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé sur eux le monde.
fr.B: Il relève le pauvre de la poussière \q et tire l’indigent du tas de cendres, \q pour le faire asseoir avec les nobles \q et lui donner en partage un trône d’honneur. \q Car les piliers de la terre appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; \q c’est sur eux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé le monde.
fr.R: Il relève les pauvres de la poussière. \q Il tire les malheureux du tas d’ordures. \q Il les fait asseoir avec les princes et leur donne des places d’honneur. \q Les fondations de la terre appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé le monde sur elles.

sw.L: Humwinua maskini kutoka mavumbini; \q kutoka jaa humpandisha mhitaji, \q ili [awakalishe] pamoja na wakuu, \q na kiti cha enzi cha heshima huwarithisha. \q Kwa maana nguzo za dunia [ni] za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q naye ameuweka ulimwengu juu yake.
sw.B: Humwinua maskini kutoka mavumbini \q na kumpandisha mhitaji kutoka jaani, \q ili awakalishe pamoja na wakuu \q na kuwapa kiti cha heshima kiwe chao. \q Kwa maana nguzo za dunia ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q juu yake ameuweka ulimwengu.
sw.R: Huwainua maskini kutoka mavumbini. \q Huwapandisha wahitaji kutoka jalalani. \q Huwakalisha pamoja na wakuu na kuwapa nafasi za heshima. \q Misingi ya dunia ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q naye ameuweka ulimwengu juu yake.

vi.L: Ngài nâng [người] nghèo lên từ bụi đất; \q từ đống tro {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhấc [người] thiếu thốn lên, \q để cho [họ] ngồi với các quý tộc, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ thừa hưởng ngôi vinh dự. \q Vì các cột trụ của đất [thuộc về] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt thế gian trên đó.
vi.B: Ngài nâng người nghèo lên khỏi bụi đất \q và nhấc người thiếu thốn lên khỏi đống tro, \q cho họ ngồi chung với các bậc quyền quý \q và ban cho họ ngôi vinh dự làm của riêng. \q Vì các cột trụ của đất thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt thế gian trên đó.
vi.R: Ngài nâng người nghèo lên khỏi bụi đất. \q Ngài nhấc người thiếu thốn lên khỏi đống rác. \q Ngài cho họ ngồi với các hoàng tử và ban cho họ chỗ ngồi danh dự. \q Nền móng của đất thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt thế gian trên đó.

ko.L: 그분께서 가난한 이를 티끌에서 일으키시고, \q 잿더미에서 궁핍한 이를 들어 올리셔서, \q 귀족들과 함께 [그들을] 앉히시고, \q 영광의 보좌를 그들에게 물려주신다. \q 땅의 기둥들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이니, \q 그분께서 그 위에 세상을 세우셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 가난한 이를 먼지 속에서 일으키시고, \q 궁핍한 이를 잿더미에서 들어 올리셔서, \q 귀족들과 함께 앉히시고 \q 영광의 자리를 그들의 몫으로 주신다. \q 땅의 기둥들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이니, \q 그분께서 그 위에 세상을 놓으셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 가난한 사람들을 흙먼지 속에서 일으키신다. \q 궁핍한 사람들을 쓰레기 더미에서 끌어올리신다. \q 그들을 높은 사람들과 함께 앉히시고 귀한 자리를 주신다. \q 땅의 기초가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이니, \q 그분께서 그 위에 세상을 세우셨다.

decisions.choice: the same words as Psalm 113:7-8
decisions.reason: The first two lines and the start of the third are almost word for word in Psalm 113:7-8, where they are followed, as here, by the barren woman who becomes a glad mother (Psalm 113:9). The wording here follows that psalm. Psalm 113:8 adds "with the nobles of his people"; this verse goes on to the throne of honor instead.

decisions.choice: the ash heap: the town's refuse heap, where the outcast and destitute sat
decisions.reason: Ash and refuse were dumped outside the town. The very poor, the sick and the shamed sat and begged there. To be lifted from it to sit among nobles is the greatest possible change of rank.

decisions.choice: a throne of honor he makes them inherit: a place of honor given to them to keep
decisions.reason: The verb means to give as an inheritance, a lasting possession. The seat is a seat of rank among the nobles.

decisions.choice: the pillars of the earth: the foundations on which the world stands
decisions.reason: The poem pictures the earth resting on pillars that God himself set in place (Psalm 75:4; 104:5). Because he made and holds up the world, he has the right to reorder it as the verse describes.

decisions.choice: ash heap (Balanced); garbage heap (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for the place where refuse was dumped.

decisions.choice: the foundations of the earth (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "foundations" for the pillars on which the earth was pictured as resting.

decisions.choice: jaa (L, B); jalala (R)
decisions.reason: "Jaa" is the refuse heap outside a town (m2); Readable uses "jalala", the everyday word for a rubbish dump, as the English says "garbage heap".

decisions.choice: "가난한 이를 티끌에서 일으키시고 ... 잿더미에서" (L); "먼지 속에서 ... 잿더미에서" (B)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew is Psalm 113:7-8 (m1); Korean takes the published Psalm 113's words for these lines so the echo is heard.

source.text: רַגְלֵ֤י חֲסִידָיו֙ יִשְׁמֹ֔ר וּרְשָׁעִ֖ים בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יִדָּ֑מּוּ כִּֽי־לֹ֥א בְכֹ֖חַ יִגְבַּר־אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] feet of his faithful [ones] he guards, and [the] wicked in darkness are silenced; for not by strength prevails a man.

en.L: [The] feet of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} guards, \q but [the] wicked are silenced in darkness; \q for not by strength does [anyone] prevail.
en.B: He guards the steps of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones, \q but the wicked are silenced in darkness, \q for no one wins by strength.
en.R: He keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people from stumbling, \q but wicked people will be silenced in the dark. \q No one wins just by being strong.

es.L: Los pies de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles guarda, \q pero los malvados son silenciados en tinieblas; \q porque no por la fuerza prevalece [nadie].
es.B: Guarda los pasos de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles, \q pero los malvados son acallados en las tinieblas, \q porque nadie triunfa por la fuerza.
es.R: Cuida a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles para que no tropiecen, \q pero los malvados quedarán callados en la oscuridad. \q Nadie gana solo por ser fuerte.

fr.L: Les pieds de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les garde, \q mais les méchants sont réduits au silence dans les ténèbres ; \q car ce n’est pas par la force qu’[un homme] l’emporte.
fr.B: Il garde les pas de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles, \q mais les méchants sont réduits au silence dans les ténèbres, \q car personne ne triomphe par sa force.
fr.R: Il empêche {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles de trébucher, \q mais les méchants seront réduits au silence dans le noir. \q Personne ne gagne seulement parce qu’il est fort.

sw.L: Miguu ya waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} huilinda, \q lakini waovu hunyamazishwa gizani; \q kwa maana si kwa nguvu [mtu] hushinda.
sw.B: Huzilinda hatua za waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q lakini waovu hunyamazishwa gizani, \q kwa maana hakuna mtu ashindaye kwa nguvu.
sw.R: Huwalinda watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu wasijikwae, \q lakini watu waovu watanyamazishwa gizani. \q Hakuna mtu ashindaye kwa sababu tu ana nguvu.

vi.L: Chân của những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ, \q còn [những kẻ] ác thì bị làm cho câm lặng trong bóng tối; \q vì không phải bởi sức mạnh mà [ai] thắng thế.
vi.B: Ngài gìn giữ bước chân những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q còn kẻ ác phải câm lặng trong bóng tối, \q vì chẳng ai thắng nhờ sức mạnh.
vi.R: Ngài giữ cho những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khỏi vấp ngã, \q còn kẻ ác sẽ phải im lặng trong bóng tối. \q Không ai thắng được chỉ nhờ sức mạnh.

ko.L: 그분의 신실한 이들의 발을 그분께서 지키시나, \q 악인들은 어둠 속에서 잠잠해진다. \q 힘으로 이기는 사람은 [아무도] 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 신실한 이들의 걸음을 지키시나, \q 악인들은 어둠 속에서 입을 다문다. \q 사람이 힘으로 이기는 것이 아니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그분께 충실한 사람들이 넘어지지 않게 지켜 주신다. \q 그러나 악한 사람들은 어둠 속에서 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 아무도 힘만으로는 이길 수 없다.

decisions.choice: his faithful ones, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "his faithful one" (singular); the reading the scribes marked (qere) is plural. The singular would speak of each faithful person in turn. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: he guards the feet: he keeps them from stumbling or falling
decisions.reason: Feet stand for a person's path through life. God keeps them from slipping into harm (Psalm 116:8; 121:3).

decisions.choice: faithful ones: those who are loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word comes from chesed, steadfast love. It names those who keep faith with God and his covenant.

decisions.choice: silenced in darkness: brought to silence in death or disaster
decisions.reason: The verb means "be silent" and is also used for being cut off or destroyed (Jeremiah 8:14; Psalm 31:18). The wicked who boasted (verse 3) are silenced; darkness is the darkness of ruin and death.

decisions.choice: a man: anyone
decisions.reason: The noun "man" is used here for any human being. No one wins by strength alone; victory comes from the LORD (verse 10; Psalm 33:16-17).

source.text: יְהוָ֞ה יֵחַ֣תּוּ מְרִיבָ֗יו עָלָיו֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יַרְעֵ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה יָדִ֣ין אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹ֣ז לְמַלְכּ֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖ם קֶ֥רֶן מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh, are shattered those contending with him; against him in the heavens he thunders; Yahweh judges [the] ends of [the] earth, and gives strength to his king, and lifts high [the] horn of his anointed.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, those who contend with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} will be shattered; \q against them in the heavens {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will thunder. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will judge the ends of the earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give strength to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king \q and lift high the horn of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed."
en.B: Those who oppose {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be shattered; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will thunder against them from heaven. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will judge the ends of the earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will grant strength to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king \q and raise high the horn of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will break to pieces everyone who fights against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He will thunder against them from the sky. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will judge the whole earth, to its farthest edges. \q He will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} king strong and give great power to the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has anointed."

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: los que contienden con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} serán destrozados; \q contra ellos tronará en los cielos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará los confines de la tierra; \q dará fuerza a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey \q y alzará el cuerno de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido».
es.B: Los que se oponen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} serán hechos pedazos; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tronará contra ellos desde el cielo. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará los confines de la tierra; \q dará poder a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey \q y levantará en alto el cuerno de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará pedazos a todos los que luchan contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Tronará contra ellos desde el cielo. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará toda la tierra, hasta sus últimos rincones. \q Hará fuerte a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey y dará gran poder al rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ungido».

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disputent seront brisés ; \q contre eux, dans les cieux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tonnera. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera les extrémités de la terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donnera la force à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi \q et élèvera la corne de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint. »
fr.B: Ceux qui s’opposent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} seront brisés ; \q du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tonnera contre eux. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera la terre jusqu’à ses extrémités ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donnera la force à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi \q et relèvera la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mettra en pièces tous ceux qui luttent contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} tonnera contre eux. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera toute la terre, jusqu’au bout du monde. \q Il rendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} roi fort et donnera une grande puissance au roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a oint. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wale wanaoshindana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} watavunjwa vipande vipande; \q atanguruma juu yao mbinguni. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahukumu miisho ya dunia; \q atampa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nguvu \q na kuiinua juu pembe ya masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}."
sw.B: Wale wanaompinga {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watavunjwa vipande vipande; \q atanguruma juu yao kutoka mbinguni. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahukumu miisho ya dunia; \q atampa mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nguvu \q na kuiinua juu pembe ya mpakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atamvunja vipande vipande kila anayepigana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. \q Atanguruma juu yao kutoka angani. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahukumu dunia yote, hadi miisho yake. \q Atamtia nguvu mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kumpa uwezo mkuu mfalme ambaye {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amempaka mafuta."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những kẻ chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị đập tan; \q từ trên các tầng trời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phát sấm sét nghịch cùng họ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xét xử các đầu cùng đất; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ban sức mạnh cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và ngẩng cao sừng của người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Những kẻ chống nghịch {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bị đập tan; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phát sấm sét từ trời nghịch cùng họ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xét xử khắp các đầu cùng đất; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ban sức mạnh cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và ngẩng cao sừng của người được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xức dầu."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đập tan mọi kẻ chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài sẽ phát sấm sét từ trời nghịch cùng họ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ xét xử cả thế gian, đến tận cùng trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ làm cho vua của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ và ban quyền lực lớn cho vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xức dầu."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분과 다투는 자들은 산산이 부서지고, \q 하늘에서 그분께서 그들에게 천둥을 치실 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅끝까지 심판하시고, \q 그분의 왕에게 힘을 주시며, \q 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이의 뿔을 높이실 것이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서는 자들은 산산이 부서지고, \q 그분께서 하늘에서 그들에게 천둥을 치실 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅끝까지 심판하시고, \q 그분의 왕에게 힘을 주시며, \q 그분께서 기름 부으신 이의 뿔을 높이 드실 것이다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서 싸우는 사람은 누구든지 그분께서 부수어 버리실 것이다. \q 그분께서 하늘에서 그들에게 천둥을 치실 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅끝까지 온 세상을 심판하실 것이다. \q 그분께서는 그분의 왕을 강하게 하시고, \q 그분께서 기름 부어 세우신 왕에게 큰 힘을 주실 것이다."

decisions.choice: will be shattered, will thunder, will judge, will give, will lift high: what the LORD will do
alternatives: those who oppose the LORD are shattered ...
may he give strength to his king
decisions.reason: The verbs are imperfect and look ahead. Hannah's song ends with what God will do, not only with what he has done. They could also be read as what God always does, or as a prayer ("may he give strength to his king").

decisions.choice: those who contend with him, as the scribes' reading has it
alternatives: the one who contends with him
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "the one who contends with him" (singular); the reading the scribes marked (qere) is plural. The pronoun in "against him" is singular in the Hebrew: the LORD thunders against each opponent. The ancient Greek translation adds a long passage here, close to Jeremiah 9:22-23 ("let not the wise boast in his wisdom ... but let the one who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows the LORD"). The Hebrew text, which governs, does not have it. Reviewers should check this note against the textual evidence.

decisions.choice: his king, his anointed: the king God will appoint and anoint
decisions.reason: This is the first time Scripture calls a king the LORD's anointed. Earlier the word was used of the anointed priest (Leviticus 4:3, 5, 16). Israel had no king yet (Judges 21:25); the song looks ahead to the kings Samuel will anoint (10:1; 16:13). The Hebrew word is mashiach, from which "Messiah" comes, and later hope looked for a final anointed king. Luke 1:69 echoes this line: God "has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of David."

decisions.choice: lift high the horn: give strength and honor
decisions.reason: The song ends with the picture it began with (verse 1). What God did for Hannah he will do for his king.

decisions.choice: thunder from heaven: God as a warrior against his enemies
decisions.reason: God's voice is heard in thunder as he fights for his people (7:10; 2 Samuel 22:14; Psalm 18:14). In 7:10 he thunders against the Philistines in Samuel's day.

decisions.choice: Those who oppose the LORD will be shattered (Balanced); The LORD will break to pieces everyone who fights against him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Hebrew puts "the LORD" first for emphasis and then says what happens to his enemies. Literal keeps that order; Balanced moves the name into the clause; Readable makes the LORD the subject, as the next line does.

decisions.choice: the king he has anointed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "his anointed". Readable says who is meant, as it does for "the LORD's anointed" throughout Samuel. The double quotation mark that opened in verse 1 closes here at every level.

decisions.choice: "SEIGNEUR, ceux qui lui disputent seront brisés"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the name first and then speaks of those who contend with him; French Literal keeps the order with the name standing alone, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido" (L, B); "el rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ungido" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: "ungido" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says who is meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} (L); mpakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} (B); mfalme aliyempaka mafuta (R)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms and Samuel notes: "masihi" at Literal, "mpakwa mafuta" (the anointed one) at Balanced, and the king he has anointed at Readable, as the English Readable says.

decisions.choice: "người được xức dầu của Ngài" (L); "người được Ngài xức dầu" (B); "vị vua Ngài đã xức dầu" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the anointed king; "Đấng Mê-si-a" would read the later title into Hannah's words, which the meaning decision does not.

decisions.choice: "그분의 기름 부음 받은 이" (L); "그분께서 기름 부으신 이" (B); "그분께서 기름 부어 세우신 왕" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for "the LORD's anointed"; Readable says that it is the king, as the English Readable does. Used for the whole block.

source.text: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֶלְקָנָ֛ה הָרָמָ֖תָה עַל־בֵּית֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֗עַר הָיָ֤ה מְשָׁרֵת֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י עֵלִ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Elkanah to Ramah to his house; and the boy was serving Yahweh in [the] presence of Eli the priest.

en.L: And Elkanah went to Ramah, to his house; and the boy was serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the presence of Eli the priest.
en.B: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy stayed and served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} under Eli the priest.
en.R: Then Elkanah went back home to Ramah. But the boy Samuel stayed at Shiloh to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} under Eli the priest.

es.L: Y Elcana se fue a Ramá, a su casa; y el niño servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en presencia del sacerdote Elí.
es.B: Luego Elcana regresó a su casa en Ramá, pero el niño se quedó sirviendo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} bajo la dirección del sacerdote Elí.
es.R: Después Elcana volvió a su casa en Ramá. Pero el niño Samuel se quedó en Silo para servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} bajo el cuidado del sacerdote Elí.

fr.L: Et Elqana s’en alla à Rama, à sa maison ; et l’enfant servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en présence d’Éli le prêtre.
fr.B: Puis Elqana rentra chez lui à Rama, mais l’enfant resta pour servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sous la conduite du prêtre Éli.
fr.R: Ensuite, Elqana est rentré chez lui, à Rama. Mais le petit Samuel est resté à Silo pour servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sous la direction du prêtre Éli.

sw.L: Na Elkana akaenda Rama, nyumbani kwake; na mtoto akawa akimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele ya Eli kuhani.
sw.B: Kisha Elkana akaenda nyumbani Rama, lakini mtoto akabaki akimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} chini ya Eli kuhani.
sw.R: Kisha Elkana akarudi nyumbani Rama. Lakini mtoto Samweli akabaki Shilo ili kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} chini ya uangalizi wa Eli kuhani.

vi.L: Ên-ca-na đi về Ra-ma, về nhà mình; còn đứa trẻ thì phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trước mặt thầy tế lễ Hê-li.
vi.B: Rồi Ên-ca-na về nhà ở Ra-ma, còn cậu bé ở lại phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dưới sự hướng dẫn của thầy tế lễ Hê-li.
vi.R: Rồi Ên-ca-na trở về nhà ở Ra-ma. Nhưng cậu bé Sa-mu-ên ở lại Si-lô để phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dưới sự hướng dẫn của thầy tế lễ Hê-li.

ko.L: 그리고 엘가나는 라마에 있는 자기 집으로 갔고, 그 아이는 제사장 엘리 앞에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기고 있었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤 엘가나는 라마에 있는 집으로 돌아갔고, 아이는 남아서 제사장 엘리 밑에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 엘가나는 라마에 있는 집으로 돌아갔다. 그러나 어린 사무엘은 실로에 남아서 제사장 엘리 밑에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다.

decisions.choice: Elkanah went home: the family returns without the boy
decisions.reason: Only Elkanah is named, as head of the family, but Hannah goes with him: verse 19 has her coming up each year with her husband. Samuel stays behind at Shiloh, as Hannah had promised (1:22, 28).

decisions.choice: serving: ministering at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The verb is used for the duties of priests and Levites in worship (Numbers 3:6; Deuteronomy 10:8). It is a word of honored service, and it returns in verse 18.

decisions.choice: in the presence of Eli: under Eli's oversight
decisions.reason: The boy serves the LORD, but under the care and direction of the old priest (3:1).

decisions.choice: stayed (Balanced, Readable); the boy Samuel, at Shiloh (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the contrast implies: Elkanah went home, but the boy stayed. Readable names Samuel and the place, which the context makes clear (1:24).

source.text: וּבְנֵ֥י עֵלִ֖י בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיָּ֑עַל לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Eli [were] sons of worthlessness; not they knew Yahweh.

en.L: And the sons of Eli [were] sons of worthlessness; they did not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Now Eli's sons were worthless men; they did not know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Eli's sons were wicked men. They had no respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y los hijos de Elí [eran] hijos de perversidad; no conocían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los hijos de Elí eran hombres perversos; no conocían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los hijos de Elí eran hombres malvados. No respetaban {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et les fils d’Éli [étaient] des fils de vaurien ; ils ne connaissaient pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Or les fils d’Éli étaient des vauriens ; ils ne connaissaient pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les fils d’Éli étaient des hommes méchants. Ils ne respectaient pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na wana wa Eli [walikuwa] wana wa ubaya; hawakumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Basi wana wa Eli walikuwa watu wasiofaa kitu; hawakumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wana wa Eli walikuwa watu waovu. Hawakumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hata kidogo.

vi.L: Các con trai của Hê-li [là] những đứa con của sự gian tà; chúng không biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các con trai của Hê-li là những kẻ vô lại; họ không biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các con trai của Hê-li là những kẻ gian ác. Họ không hề kính trọng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리의 아들들은 쓸모없는 자들이었다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알지 못했다.
ko.B: 엘리의 아들들은 불량배였다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알지 못했다.
ko.R: 엘리의 아들들은 악한 사람들이었다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 조금도 두려워하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: sons of worthlessness: good-for-nothing, wicked men
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls people "sons of" a quality they show. The word beliyya'al means worthlessness or wickedness (Deuteronomy 13:14; Judges 19:22). Hannah had begged Eli not to count her "a daughter of worthlessness" (1:16); the irony is that his own sons are the worthless ones.

decisions.choice: they did not know the LORD: they did not acknowledge or honor him
decisions.reason: To know the LORD is more than to know about him: it is to recognize his claim and live by it (Judges 2:10; Jeremiah 22:16). These are priests who serve at his altar, yet they do not know him.

decisions.choice: Eli's sons: Hophni and Phinehas, priests at Shiloh
decisions.reason: They were named in 1:3, and their names return in verse 34.

decisions.choice: they had no respect for (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "not knowing" the LORD meant here, as the next verses show.

decisions.choice: "fils de vaurien" (Literal); "des vauriens" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "des vauriens" for "sons of worthlessness". Literal keeps the Hebrew shape "fils de", with the same noun; "Bélial", taken as a name in older versions, would add a figure the Hebrew word does not name here (m1).

decisions.choice: "hijos de perversidad" (L); "hombres perversos" (B); "hombres malvados" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note ("sons of Belial"): Literal keeps the Hebrew "sons of" with an ordinary noun, and Balanced and Readable say what kind of men they were (m1). "Belial" reads to most readers as a proper name, which it is not here.

decisions.choice: wana wa ubaya (L); watu wasiofaa kitu (B); watu waovu (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "sons of Belial" are "watu wasiofaa kitu" at Balanced; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, and Readable says "waovu", as the English Readable says "wicked".

decisions.choice: "những kẻ vô lại" (B) for "sons of worthlessness"; Literal keeps "những đứa con của sự gian tà"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for "worthless men"; Readable says "kẻ gian ác", as the English "wicked".

decisions.choice: "쓸모없는 자들" (L); "불량배" (B); "악한 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: "Sons of worthlessness" (m1): the Samuel terms note sets "불량배" for these men; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "worthless", and Readable says "wicked", as the English Readable does.

source.text: וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־הָעָ֑ם כָּל־אִ֞ישׁ זֹבֵ֣חַ זֶ֗בַח וּבָ֨א נַ֤עַר הַכֹּהֵן֙ כְּבַשֵּׁ֣ל הַבָּשָׂ֔ר וְהַמַּזְלֵ֛ג שְׁלֹ֥שׁ־הַשִּׁנַּ֖יִם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] custom of the priests with the people: any man sacrificing a sacrifice, and would come [the] servant of the priest as the meat was boiling, and the fork of three prongs in his hand,

en.L: And the custom of the priests with the people [was this]: whenever any man offered a sacrifice, the priest's servant would come while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three prongs in his hand,
en.B: Now this was the priests' practice with the people: whenever anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest's servant would come while the meat was boiling, carrying a three-pronged fork,
en.R: This is how the priests treated the people. Whenever someone offered a sacrifice, the priest's servant came while the meat was still boiling. He carried a large fork with three prongs.

es.L: Y la costumbre de los sacerdotes con el pueblo [era esta]: cuando alguien ofrecía un sacrificio, venía el criado del sacerdote mientras se cocía la carne, con un tenedor de tres puntas en la mano,
es.B: Esta era la práctica de los sacerdotes con el pueblo: cada vez que alguien ofrecía un sacrificio, el criado del sacerdote llegaba mientras se cocía la carne, con un tenedor de tres puntas en la mano,
es.R: Así trataban los sacerdotes a la gente. Cada vez que alguien ofrecía un sacrificio, el criado del sacerdote llegaba mientras la carne todavía estaba hirviendo. Llevaba un tenedor grande de tres puntas.

fr.L: Et la coutume des prêtres avec le peuple [était celle-ci] : chaque fois qu’un homme offrait un sacrifice, le serviteur du prêtre venait pendant que la viande cuisait, une fourchette à trois dents à la main,
fr.B: Voici comment les prêtres agissaient avec le peuple : chaque fois que quelqu’un offrait un sacrifice, le serviteur du prêtre venait pendant que la viande cuisait, avec une fourchette à trois dents,
fr.R: Voici comment les prêtres traitaient les gens. Chaque fois que quelqu’un offrait un sacrifice, le serviteur du prêtre arrivait pendant que la viande était encore en train de cuire. Il tenait une grande fourchette à trois dents.

sw.L: Na desturi ya makuhani pamoja na watu [ilikuwa hii]: kila mtu alipotoa dhabihu, mtumishi wa kuhani angekuja nyama ilipokuwa ikichemka, akiwa na uma wa meno matatu mkononi mwake,
sw.B: Basi hii ndiyo iliyokuwa desturi ya makuhani kwa watu: kila mtu alipotoa dhabihu, mtumishi wa kuhani alikuja nyama ilipokuwa ikichemka, akiwa amebeba uma wenye meno matatu,
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo makuhani walivyowatendea watu. Kila mara mtu alipotoa dhabihu, mtumishi wa kuhani alikuja nyama ilipokuwa bado ikichemka. Alibeba uma mkubwa wenye meno matatu.

vi.L: Lệ thường của các thầy tế lễ đối với dân [là thế này]: hễ có ai dâng sinh tế, thì đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đến trong khi thịt đang luộc, tay cầm một cái chĩa ba răng,
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ có lệ thường đối với dân như sau: hễ có ai dâng sinh tế, thì trong khi thịt còn đang luộc, đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đến, tay cầm chĩa ba răng,
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ đối xử với dân như thế này. Mỗi khi có người dâng sinh tế, đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đến trong lúc thịt còn đang luộc. Hắn cầm một cái chĩa lớn có ba răng.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들이 백성에게 하는 관습은 [이러했다]. 누구든지 제사를 드리면, 고기를 삶고 있을 때 제사장의 종이 세 갈래 갈고리를 손에 들고 와서,
ko.B: 제사장들이 백성에게 하는 버릇은 이러했다. 누가 제사를 드리면, 고기를 삶고 있을 때 제사장의 종이 세 갈래 갈고리를 들고 와서,
ko.R: 제사장들은 백성을 이렇게 대했다. 누가 제사를 드리면, 고기가 아직 삶아지고 있을 때 제사장의 종이 왔다. 그는 세 갈래로 된 큰 갈고리를 들고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the custom of the priests: what they had made their practice
alternatives: the priests' right from the people
decisions.reason: The noun often means a legal right or ruling, and the law did give the priest a share of each peace offering: the breast and the right thigh (Leviticus 7:31-34; compare Deuteronomy 18:3). Here it is the practice Eli's sons had made for themselves, taking more than their share, and taking it before God's portion was burned (verse 15).

decisions.choice: a new sentence begins with "the custom of the priests"
alternatives: they did not know the LORD, nor the priests' rightful share from the people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verse division starts a new sentence here. The ancient Greek translation joins the words to the end of verse 12: the sons did not know the LORD "or the priests' due from the people". The Hebrew division governs.

decisions.choice: a sacrifice: a peace offering, which the worshiper's family ate
decisions.reason: In this kind of sacrifice the fat was burned on the altar for the LORD, the priest received his set portion, and the rest of the meat was boiled and eaten by the family in a meal at the sanctuary (1:4; Leviticus 7:11-18, 28-34).

decisions.choice: would come, would thrust: something done again and again
decisions.reason: The verb forms describe a habit, what happened every time someone sacrificed, not one occasion.

decisions.choice: whenever any man (Literal); whenever anyone (Balanced); whenever someone (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the words side by side, "any man sacrificing a sacrifice"; English needs "whenever". Balanced and Readable use words that include any worshiper.

source.text: וְהִכָּ֨ה בַכִּיּ֜וֹר א֣וֹ בַדּ֗וּד א֤וֹ בַקַּלַּ֨חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַפָּר֔וּר כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲלֶ֣ה הַמַּזְלֵ֔ג יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בּ֑וֹ כָּ֚כָה יַעֲשׂ֣וּ לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and he would thrust into the pan or into the kettle or into the cauldron or into the pot; all that brought up the fork would take the priest for himself. Thus they did to all Israel who came there to Shiloh.

en.L: and he would thrust [it] into the pan, or into the kettle, or into the cauldron, or into the pot; all that the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. Thus they did to all Israel who came there, to Shiloh.
en.B: and he would plunge it into the pan or kettle or cauldron or pot. Whatever the fork brought up, the priest took for himself. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.
en.R: He would stab the fork into the cooking pot, and the priest kept for himself whatever meat came up on it. They did this to every Israelite who came to Shiloh.

es.L: y lo metía en la olla, o en el caldero, o en la caldera, o en la marmita; todo lo que sacaba el tenedor, el sacerdote lo tomaba para sí. Así hacían con todo Israel que llegaba allí, a Silo.
es.B: y lo hundía en la olla, el caldero, la caldera o la marmita. Todo lo que el tenedor sacaba, el sacerdote se lo quedaba. Así trataban a todos los israelitas que llegaban allí, a Silo.
es.R: Clavaba el tenedor en la olla, y el sacerdote se quedaba con toda la carne que salía en él. Eso hacían con todos los israelitas que llegaban a Silo.

fr.L: et il piquait dans le bassin, ou dans le chaudron, ou dans la marmite, ou dans le pot ; tout ce que la fourchette ramenait, le prêtre le prenait pour lui. Ainsi faisaient-ils à tout Israël qui venait là, à Silo.
fr.B: et il la plongeait dans le bassin, le chaudron, la marmite ou le pot. Tout ce que la fourchette ramenait, le prêtre le prenait pour lui. Voilà comment ils traitaient tous les Israélites qui venaient là, à Silo.
fr.R: Il plantait la fourchette dans la marmite, et le prêtre gardait pour lui toute la viande qu’elle ramenait. Ils faisaient cela à tous les Israélites qui venaient à Silo.

sw.L: naye angeuchomeka ndani ya kikaango, au ndani ya birika, au ndani ya sufuria kubwa, au ndani ya chungu; kila kitu ambacho uma ulikipandisha kuhani angejichukulia. Ndivyo walivyowatendea Israeli wote waliokuja huko, Shilo.
sw.B: naye aliuchomeka ndani ya kikaango au birika au sufuria au chungu. Chochote ambacho uma ulipandisha, kuhani alijichukulia. Ndivyo walivyowatendea Waisraeli wote waliokuja huko Shilo.
sw.R: Aliuchomeka uma ndani ya chungu cha kupikia, na kuhani alijichukulia nyama yoyote iliyotoka juu yake. Walifanya hivi kwa kila Mwisraeli aliyekuja Shilo.

vi.L: và hắn thọc [nó] vào chảo, hoặc vào nồi, hoặc vào vạc, hoặc vào niêu; hễ cái chĩa móc lên được bao nhiêu thì thầy tế lễ lấy cho mình bấy nhiêu. Họ làm như vậy với cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đến đó, tại Si-lô.
vi.B: và hắn thọc chĩa vào chảo, nồi, vạc hay niêu. Chĩa móc lên được gì thì thầy tế lễ lấy nấy cho mình. Họ đối xử như vậy với mọi người Y-sơ-ra-ên đến Si-lô.
vi.R: Hắn đâm cái chĩa vào nồi nấu, và thầy tế lễ giữ lấy cho mình bất cứ miếng thịt nào dính vào chĩa. Họ làm như vậy với mọi người Y-sơ-ra-ên đến Si-lô.

ko.L: 냄비나 솥이나 가마나 단지에 [그것을] 찔러 넣었고, 갈고리에 걸려 올라오는 것은 모두 제사장이 자기 몫으로 가져갔다. 실로에 와서 거기 있는 모든 이스라엘 사람에게 그들이 이렇게 했다.
ko.B: 냄비든 솥이든 가마든 단지든 그 속에 갈고리를 찔러 넣었다. 그리고 갈고리에 걸려 나오는 것은 무엇이든 제사장이 자기 것으로 가져갔다. 실로에 오는 모든 이스라엘 사람에게 그들은 이렇게 했다.
ko.R: 종은 그 갈고리로 고기 삶는 솥을 쿡 찔렀다. 그러면 갈고리에 걸려 나오는 고기는 무엇이든 제사장이 가졌다. 그들은 실로에 오는 이스라엘 사람 모두에게 이렇게 했다.

decisions.choice: pan, kettle, cauldron, pot: cooking pots of different kinds
decisions.reason: The four words name different vessels for boiling meat. Their exact shapes are not known. Listed together, they mean whatever pot the meat was in.

decisions.choice: whatever the fork brought up the priest took: a share left to chance and greed
decisions.reason: The law named the parts that belonged to the priest (Leviticus 7:31-34). Here the priest takes whatever the fork happens to bring up, from the worshipers' own share of the meal.

decisions.choice: the priest: whichever priest sent the servant
decisions.reason: The singular speaks of each priest in turn; from verses 12 and 17 it is Eli's sons who did this.

decisions.choice: the cooking pot (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable gives one word for the four kinds of pot, since the point is that any pot would do.

source.text: גַּם֮ בְּטֶרֶם֮ יַקְטִר֣וּן אֶת־הַחֵלֶב֒ וּבָ֣א׀נַ֣עַר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַר֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֹּבֵ֔חַ תְּנָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר לִצְל֖וֹת לַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְלֹֽא־יִקַּ֧ח מִמְּךָ֛ בָּשָׂ֥ר מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל כִּ֥י אִם־חָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Also before they made smoke [of] the fat, and would come [the] servant of the priest and say to the man sacrificing, give meat to roast for the priest; and not he will take from you meat boiled, but only raw.

en.L: Even before they turned the fat into smoke, the priest's servant would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, "Give meat to roast for the priest; he will not take boiled meat from you, only raw."
en.B: Worse still, before the fat had even been turned into smoke, the priest's servant would come and tell the man offering the sacrifice, "Hand over some meat for the priest to roast. He will not accept boiled meat from you, only raw."
en.R: Even before the fat was burned on the altar, the priest's servant would come. He would say to the man offering the sacrifice, "Give the priest some meat to roast. He will not take boiled meat from you. He wants it raw."

es.L: Incluso antes de que hicieran humear la grasa, venía el criado del sacerdote y decía al hombre que sacrificaba: «Da carne para asar al sacerdote; no tomará de ti carne cocida, sino solo cruda».
es.B: Peor aún: antes de que la grasa se hubiera convertido en humo, llegaba el criado del sacerdote y le decía al que ofrecía el sacrificio: «Entrega carne para que el sacerdote la ase. No te aceptará carne cocida, solo cruda».
es.R: Incluso antes de que quemaran la grasa en el altar, llegaba el criado del sacerdote. Le decía al hombre que ofrecía el sacrificio: «Dale al sacerdote carne para asar. No te va a aceptar carne cocida. La quiere cruda».

fr.L: Même avant qu’on fasse fumer la graisse, le serviteur du prêtre venait et disait à l’homme qui sacrifiait : « Donne de la viande à rôtir pour le prêtre ; il ne prendra pas de toi de la viande bouillie, mais seulement crue. »
fr.B: Pire encore : avant même qu’on ait fait fumer la graisse, le serviteur du prêtre venait dire à celui qui offrait le sacrifice : « Donne de la viande à rôtir pour le prêtre. Il n’acceptera pas de toi de viande bouillie, seulement de la viande crue. »
fr.R: Avant même que la graisse soit brûlée sur l’autel, le serviteur du prêtre arrivait. Il disait à l’homme qui offrait le sacrifice : « Donne au prêtre de la viande à rôtir. Il ne veut pas de viande cuite à l’eau. Il la veut crue. »

sw.L: Hata kabla hawajayafukiza mafuta, mtumishi wa kuhani angekuja na kumwambia mtu aliyekuwa akitoa dhabihu, "Toa nyama ya kumchomea kuhani; hatachukua kwako nyama iliyochemshwa, ila mbichi tu."
sw.B: Zaidi ya hayo, hata kabla mafuta hayajateketezwa yakawa moshi, mtumishi wa kuhani alikuja na kumwambia mtu aliyekuwa akitoa dhabihu, "Lete nyama kuhani aichome. Hatakubali kwako nyama iliyochemshwa, ila mbichi tu."
sw.R: Hata kabla mafuta hayajateketezwa juu ya madhabahu, mtumishi wa kuhani alikuja. Alimwambia mtu aliyekuwa akitoa dhabihu, "Mpe kuhani nyama ya kuchoma. Hatachukua kwako nyama iliyochemshwa. Anataka mbichi."

vi.L: Ngay cả trước khi người ta đốt mỡ cho bốc khói, đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đã đến và nói với người đang dâng sinh tế: "Hãy đưa thịt để nướng cho thầy tế lễ; ông ấy sẽ không nhận thịt luộc của ông, mà chỉ [nhận thịt] sống."
vi.B: Tệ hơn nữa, ngay cả trước khi mỡ được đốt cho bốc khói, đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đã đến bảo người dâng sinh tế: "Hãy đưa thịt cho thầy tế lễ nướng. Ông ấy không nhận thịt luộc của ông đâu, chỉ nhận thịt sống thôi."
vi.R: Thậm chí trước khi mỡ được đốt trên bàn thờ, đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ đã đến. Hắn nói với người dâng sinh tế: "Hãy đưa thịt cho thầy tế lễ nướng. Ông ấy không nhận thịt luộc của ông đâu. Ông ấy muốn thịt sống."

ko.L: 기름을 태워 연기로 올리기도 전에, 제사장의 종이 와서 제사를 드리는 사람에게 말하곤 했다. "제사장께 구울 고기를 내놓아라. 그분은 너에게서 삶은 고기는 받지 않으시고, 오직 날고기만 [받으신다]."
ko.B: 더 심한 것은, 기름을 태워 연기로 올리기도 전에 제사장의 종이 와서 제사 드리는 사람에게 말했다. "제사장님께 구워 드릴 고기를 내놓아라. 그분은 삶은 고기는 받지 않으시고 날고기만 받으신다."
ko.R: 기름을 제단에서 태우기도 전에 제사장의 종이 왔다. 그는 제물을 바치는 사람에게 말했다. "제사장님께 구워 드릴 고기를 좀 내놓아라. 그분은 삶은 고기는 안 받으신다. 날고기를 원하신다."

decisions.choice: before the fat was burned: they took their share before God received his
decisions.reason: The fat of every peace offering belonged to the LORD and had to be burned on the altar first (Leviticus 3:16-17; 7:30-31). Taking meat before that put the priests ahead of God.

decisions.choice: roast, not boiled: the priest wanted the better meat, chosen raw
decisions.reason: Roasting was the finer way to cook meat. Taking it raw also let the priest pick the best pieces before anything was cooked.

decisions.choice: they turned the fat into smoke: the people offering, or anyone burning it
decisions.reason: The subject "they" is general: before anyone had burned the fat.

decisions.choice: turned the fat into smoke (Literal, Balanced); was burned on the altar (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke, the word used for burning offerings on the altar in Leviticus. Readable says "burned on the altar".

decisions.choice: yafukiza mafuta (L); kuteketezwa yakawa moshi (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is to turn into smoke; Literal says "kufukiza", Balanced spells out that the fat burns into smoke, Readable that it burns on the altar, as the English levels do.
