decisions.choice: The priest's servant speaks to the worshiper in the plain style (해라체); the worshiper answers him politely
alternatives: the polite style from the servant
decisions.reason: The servant's plain style to a grown man who has come to worship shows his arrogance, which the scene describes.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הָאִ֗ישׁ קַטֵּ֨ר יַקְטִיר֤וּן כַּיּוֹם֙ הַחֵ֔לֶב וְקַ֨ח־לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְאָמַ֥ר׀לֹא֙ כִּ֚י עַתָּ֣ה תִתֵּ֔ן וְאִם־לֹ֖א לָקַ֥חְתִּי בְחָזְקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And would say to him the man, let them surely make smoke as the day [of] the fat, and take for yourself as desires your appetite; and he would say, no, for now you will give, and if not, I will take by force.

en.L: And [if] the man said to him, "Let them be sure to turn the fat into smoke first, and then take for yourself whatever your appetite desires," he would say, "No! You will give [it] now; and if not, I will take [it] by force."
en.B: If the man answered, "Let the fat be turned into smoke first, and then take whatever you like," the servant would say, "No, hand it over now. If you do not, I will take it by force."
en.R: The man might say, "First let the fat be burned up, as it should be. Then take as much as you want." But the servant would answer, "No! Give it to me now. If you do not, I will take it by force."

es.L: Y [si] el hombre le decía: «Que hagan humear primero la grasa, y luego toma para ti lo que desee tu apetito», él respondía: «¡No! Ahora mismo [la] darás; y si no, [la] tomaré por la fuerza».
es.B: Si el hombre contestaba: «Que primero se convierta la grasa en humo, y después toma lo que quieras», el criado decía: «No, entrégala ahora. Si no, la tomaré por la fuerza».
es.R: Si el hombre le decía: «Primero hay que quemar la grasa, como se debe. Después llévate todo lo que quieras», el criado respondía: «¡No! Dámela ahora. Si no, me la llevaré por la fuerza».

fr.L: Et [si] l’homme lui disait : « Qu’on fasse d’abord fumer la graisse, et ensuite prends pour toi ce que ton âme désire », il disait : « Non ! C’est maintenant que tu [la] donneras, sinon je [la] prendrai de force. »
fr.B: Si l’homme répondait : « Qu’on fasse d’abord fumer la graisse, puis tu prendras ce que tu voudras », le serviteur disait : « Non, donne-la tout de suite ! Sinon, je la prendrai de force. »
fr.R: L’homme pouvait dire : « Il faut d’abord brûler la graisse, comme il se doit. Ensuite, prends tout ce que tu veux. » Mais le serviteur répondait : « Non ! Donne-la-moi tout de suite. Sinon, je la prendrai de force. »

sw.L: Na [kama] mtu yule angemwambia, "Na wayafukize mafuta kwanza kabisa, kisha ujichukulie kama nafsi yako inavyotamani," angesema, "Hapana! Utatoa sasa; na kama sivyo, nitachukua kwa nguvu."
sw.B: Kama mtu yule alijibu, "Mafuta yateketezwe kwanza yawe moshi, kisha uchukue chochote unachotaka," yule mtumishi angesema, "Hapana, toa sasa hivi. Usipotoa, nitachukua kwa nguvu."
sw.R: Huenda mtu yule angesema, "Acha mafuta yateketezwe kwanza, kama inavyopaswa. Kisha chukua kiasi chochote unachotaka." Lakini mtumishi angejibu, "Hapana! Nipe sasa hivi. Usiponipa, nitachukua kwa nguvu."

vi.L: [Nếu] người ấy nói với hắn: "Phải để người ta đốt mỡ cho bốc khói trước đã, rồi anh muốn lấy gì tùy ý thì lấy," thì hắn nói: "Không! Ông phải đưa [nó] ngay bây giờ; nếu không, tôi sẽ lấy bằng vũ lực."
vi.B: Nếu người ấy đáp: "Hãy để mỡ được đốt cho bốc khói trước đã, rồi anh muốn lấy gì thì lấy," thì tên đầy tớ nói: "Không, đưa ngay bây giờ. Nếu không, tôi sẽ lấy bằng vũ lực."
vi.R: Người ấy có thể nói: "Hãy đốt hết mỡ trước, như phải làm. Rồi anh muốn lấy bao nhiêu thì lấy." Nhưng tên đầy tớ đáp: "Không! Đưa ngay cho tôi. Nếu không, tôi sẽ lấy bằng vũ lực."

ko.L: 그리고 그 사람이 그에게 "먼저 기름을 반드시 태워 연기로 올리게 하고, 그다음에 당신 마음이 원하는 대로 가져가십시오" 하고 말하면, 그는 "아니다. 지금 내놓아라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 억지로 빼앗겠다" 하고 말했다.
ko.B: 그 사람이 "먼저 기름을 태워 연기로 올린 다음에 원하는 만큼 가져가십시오" 하고 대답하면, 종은 "아니다, 지금 당장 내놓아라. 그렇지 않으면 억지로라도 빼앗겠다" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 그 사람이 "먼저 기름을 태워 드려야 합니다. 그다음에 원하는 만큼 가져가십시오" 하고 말할 때도 있었다. 그러면 종은 "안 된다! 지금 내놓아라. 안 주면 억지로 빼앗겠다" 하고 대답했다.

decisions.choice: no, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The reading the scribes marked (qere) is lo', "no". The written consonants (ketiv) have the word that sounds the same but means "to him": "he would say to him, 'You will give it now.'" The meaning is the same: the servant refuses to wait.

decisions.choice: as the day: first, without delay
decisions.reason: The phrase means "at once" or "first, as is right". The worshiper asks only that God's portion come first, as the law required.

decisions.choice: as your appetite desires: whatever you want
decisions.reason: The noun nefesh here means appetite or desire. The worshiper offers the priest all he wants, once the fat is burned.

decisions.choice: the servant (Balanced, Readable); as it should be (Readable)
decisions.reason: Hebrew says only "he would say". Balanced and Readable name the servant so the reader knows who refuses. Readable adds "as it should be" to show that the worshiper asks only for what the law required.

decisions.choice: the worshiper calls the servant "anh"; the servant calls the worshiper "ông" and himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: A worshiper and a priest's young servant who are strangers; the servant's demand is rude in what it says, not in its pronouns.

source.text: וַתְּהִ֨י חַטַּ֧את הַנְּעָרִ֛ים גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹ֖ד אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִֽאֲצוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] sin of the young men very great in [the] presence of Yahweh, for treated with contempt the men the offering of Yahweh.

en.L: And the sin of the young men was very great before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for the men treated the offering of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with contempt.
en.B: So the sin of these young men was very great in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for they treated {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s offering with contempt.
en.R: These young men were sinning very greatly against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They treated the offerings people brought to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as if they did not matter.

es.L: Y el pecado de los jóvenes era muy grande delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque los hombres trataban con desprecio la ofrenda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Así que el pecado de aquellos jóvenes era muy grave a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque trataban con desprecio la ofrenda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Estos jóvenes pecaban gravemente contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Trataban las ofrendas que la gente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traía como si no tuvieran ninguna importancia.

fr.L: Et le péché des jeunes gens fut très grand devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car les hommes méprisaient l’offrande {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le péché de ces jeunes gens était donc très grand aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car ils traitaient avec mépris l’offrande {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ces jeunes hommes commettaient un très grand péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils traitaient les offrandes que les gens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} apportaient comme si elles n’avaient aucune importance.

sw.L: Na dhambi ya vijana hao ilikuwa kubwa sana mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana watu hao walidharau sadaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo dhambi ya vijana hao ilikuwa kubwa mno machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu walidharau sadaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Vijana hao walikuwa wakitenda dhambi kubwa sana dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walizichukulia sadaka ambazo watu walimletea {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kana kwamba si kitu.

vi.L: Tội của những người trẻ ấy rất lớn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì những người ấy khinh dể lễ vật của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vậy tội của những thanh niên này rất lớn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì họ khinh dể lễ vật dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Những thanh niên này phạm tội rất nặng với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ coi thường những lễ vật người ta dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그 젊은이들의 죄가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 매우 컸으니, 그 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제물을 업신여겼기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이렇게 이 젊은이들의 죄는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 매우 컸다. 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리는 제물을 업신여겼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이 젊은이들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 아주 큰 죄를 짓고 있었다. 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 가져온 제물을 아무것도 아닌 것처럼 여겼기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the young men: Eli's sons
decisions.reason: The word can mean servants, as it does in verses 13 and 15, but here it points to Eli's sons, whose sin the passage describes (verses 12, 22-25). They are young compared with their father.

decisions.choice: the men treated the offering with contempt: the priests, or the people
alternatives: the people came to treat the LORD's offering with contempt
decisions.reason: "The men" most likely means the same young men, who despised the offering. It could also mean that because of them, the people came to despise the LORD's offering. Either way the guilt lies with the priests.

decisions.choice: the offering of the LORD: every gift brought to God, not only grain
decisions.reason: The noun minchah can name the grain offering (Leviticus 2), but here it means any offering given to the LORD.

decisions.choice: as if they did not matter (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "treated with contempt" in plain words.

source.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל מְשָׁרֵ֖ת אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה נַ֕עַר חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And Samuel [was] serving in [the] presence of Yahweh, a boy girded [with an] ephod of linen.

en.L: But Samuel was serving before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a boy girded with a linen ephod.
en.B: Samuel, meanwhile, was serving before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a boy wearing a linen ephod.
en.R: But the boy Samuel served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He wore a linen ephod, a simple garment that priests wore.

es.L: Pero Samuel servía delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, un niño ceñido con un efod de lino.
es.B: Samuel, entretanto, servía delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; era un niño vestido con un efod de lino.
es.R: Pero el niño Samuel servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Llevaba puesto un efod de lino, una prenda sencilla que usaban los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Mais Samuel servait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, un enfant ceint d’un éphod de lin.
fr.B: Samuel, lui, servait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’était un enfant vêtu d’un éphod de lin.
fr.R: Mais le petit Samuel servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il portait un éphod de lin, un vêtement simple que portaient les prêtres.

sw.L: Lakini Samweli alikuwa akihudumu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtoto aliyejifunga efodi ya kitani.
sw.B: Wakati huo Samweli alikuwa akihudumu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtoto aliyevaa efodi ya kitani.
sw.R: Lakini mtoto Samweli alimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alivaa efodi ya kitani, vazi rahisi ambalo makuhani walilivaa.

vi.L: Còn Sa-mu-ên thì phục vụ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là một cậu bé thắt áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.B: Trong khi đó, Sa-mu-ên phục vụ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là một cậu bé mặc áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.R: Nhưng cậu bé Sa-mu-ên phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Cậu mặc một áo ê-phót bằng vải gai, là loại áo đơn giản các thầy tế lễ thường mặc.

ko.L: 그러나 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 섬기고 있었는데, 베 에봇을 띠를 두른 아이였다.
ko.B: 한편 사무엘은 베 에봇을 입은 어린아이로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 섬기고 있었다.
ko.R: 그러나 어린 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다. 그는 베 에봇을 입고 있었는데, 그것은 제사장들이 입는 간단한 옷이었다.

decisions.choice: but Samuel: the story sets the boy against Eli's sons
decisions.reason: The sentence starts with Samuel's name, a contrast with the young men of verse 17. The chapter moves back and forth between Samuel and Eli's sons (verses 11, 18, 21, 26).

decisions.choice: a linen ephod: a simple garment worn by those serving at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The plain linen ephod was worn by priests (22:18) and by David when he danced before the ark (2 Samuel 6:14). It was different from the high priest's richly made ephod with its breastpiece (Exodus 28:6-14), the ephod Eli's family carried (verse 28).

decisions.choice: a simple garment that priests wore (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "ephod" and explains it briefly.

decisions.choice: efodi ya kitani
decisions.reason: As the terms notes: the ephod keeps its name, "efodi", at every level; Readable adds a short explanation, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "áo ê-phót bằng vải gai"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the linen ephod; the narrator calls the boy "cậu bé" and "cậu" through chapters 2-3.

decisions.choice: "베 에봇"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; "베" is the plain word for linen. Readable says what an ephod was, as the English Readable does. Used for the whole block.

source.text: וּמְעִ֤יל קָטֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ אִמּ֔וֹ וְהַעַלְתָ֥ה ל֖וֹ מִיָּמִ֣ים׀יָמִ֑ימָה בַּֽעֲלוֹתָהּ֙ אֶת־אִישָׁ֔הּ לִזְבֹּ֖חַ אֶת־זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And a robe small would make for him his mother, and bring [it] up to him from days to days, in her going up with her husband to sacrifice the sacrifice of the days.

en.L: And his mother would make him a little robe and bring [it] up to him from year to year, when she went up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
en.B: Each year his mother made him a small robe and brought it to him when she went up with her husband for the yearly sacrifice.
en.R: Every year his mother made him a little robe. She brought it to him when she and her husband came to offer the yearly sacrifice.

es.L: Y su madre le hacía un manto pequeño y se lo subía de año en año, cuando subía con su marido para ofrecer el sacrificio anual.
es.B: Cada año su madre le hacía un manto pequeño y se lo llevaba cuando subía con su marido para el sacrificio anual.
es.R: Todos los años su madre le hacía un mantito. Se lo llevaba cuando ella y su marido venían a ofrecer el sacrificio de cada año.

fr.L: Et sa mère lui faisait un petit manteau et le lui apportait d’année en année, quand elle montait avec son mari pour offrir le sacrifice annuel.
fr.B: Chaque année, sa mère lui faisait un petit manteau et le lui apportait quand elle montait avec son mari pour le sacrifice annuel.
fr.R: Tous les ans, sa mère lui faisait un petit manteau. Elle le lui apportait quand elle venait avec son mari offrir le sacrifice annuel.

sw.L: Na mama yake angemshonea kanzu ndogo na kumletea mwaka kwa mwaka, alipopanda pamoja na mumewe kutoa dhabihu ya mwaka.
sw.B: Kila mwaka mama yake alimshonea kanzu ndogo na kumletea alipopanda pamoja na mumewe kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya mwaka.
sw.R: Kila mwaka mama yake alimshonea kanzu ndogo. Alimletea alipokuja pamoja na mumewe kutoa dhabihu ya kila mwaka.

vi.L: Mẹ cậu [thường] may cho cậu một cái áo choàng nhỏ và đem lên cho cậu từ năm này sang năm khác, khi bà đi lên với chồng để dâng sinh tế hằng năm.
vi.B: Mỗi năm mẹ cậu may cho cậu một cái áo choàng nhỏ và đem đến cho cậu khi bà cùng chồng đi lên dâng sinh tế hằng năm.
vi.R: Năm nào mẹ cậu cũng may cho cậu một chiếc áo choàng nhỏ. Bà đem áo đến cho cậu khi bà cùng chồng lên dâng sinh tế hằng năm.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 어머니는 그에게 작은 겉옷을 만들어, 해마다 남편과 함께 해마다 드리는 제사를 드리러 올라갈 때 그것을 가지고 올라가곤 했다.
ko.B: 그의 어머니는 해마다 작은 겉옷을 만들어, 남편과 함께 해마다 드리는 제사를 드리러 올라갈 때 그에게 가져다주었다.
ko.R: 해마다 사무엘의 어머니는 작은 겉옷을 만들었다. 그리고 남편과 함께 해마다 드리는 제사를 드리러 올 때 그 옷을 사무엘에게 가져다주었다.

decisions.choice: from days to days, the sacrifice of the days: year by year, the yearly sacrifice
decisions.reason: "Days" here means a full round of days, a year, as in 1:3, 21.

decisions.choice: a robe: an outer garment
decisions.reason: The me'il was a sleeveless outer robe. Samuel's robe comes back in his story (15:27; 28:14). His mother's care continues though she has given him to the LORD.

decisions.choice: from year to year (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal says "year" because "from days to days" would not be understood. The gloss keeps the Hebrew.

source.text: וּבֵרַ֨ךְ עֵלִ֜י אֶת־אֶלְקָנָ֣ה וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וְאָמַר֙ יָשֵׂם֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ זֶ֨רַע֙ מִן־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את תַּ֚חַת הַשְּׁאֵלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖ל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהָלְכ֖וּ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And would bless Eli Elkanah and his wife and say, may set Yahweh for you offspring from the woman this in place of the request which he asked for Yahweh. And they would go to his place.

en.L: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife and say, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you offspring from this woman in place of the one asked for, who was asked for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." And they would go to his place.
en.B: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife and say, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she asked for and gave to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." Then they would go home.
en.R: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife. He would say to Elkanah, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you more children by this woman. They will take the place of the child she asked for and gave back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}." Then they would go back home.

es.L: Y Elí bendecía a Elcana y a su esposa, y decía: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé descendencia de esta mujer en lugar del que fue pedido, que fue pedido para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}». Y ellos se iban a su lugar.
es.B: Elí bendecía a Elcana y a su esposa, diciendo: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé hijos de esta mujer que ocupen el lugar del que ella pidió y entregó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}». Luego ellos regresaban a su casa.
es.R: Elí bendecía a Elcana y a su esposa. Le decía a Elcana: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé más hijos de esta mujer. Ellos ocuparán el lugar del niño que ella pidió y luego devolvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}». Después regresaban a su casa.

fr.L: Et Éli bénissait Elqana et sa femme et disait : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne une descendance de cette femme à la place de celui qui a été demandé, qui a été demandé pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. » Et ils s’en allaient chez eux.
fr.B: Éli bénissait Elqana et sa femme en disant : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne des enfants de cette femme, pour remplacer celui qu’elle a demandé et qu’elle a donné {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. » Puis ils rentraient chez eux.
fr.R: Éli bénissait Elqana et sa femme. Il disait à Elqana : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne d’autres enfants avec cette femme. Ils remplaceront l’enfant qu’elle a demandé et qu’elle a rendu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. » Puis ils rentraient chez eux.

sw.L: Na Eli angewabariki Elkana na mkewe na kusema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe uzao kutoka kwa mwanamke huyu badala ya yule aliyeombwa, aliyeombwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Nao wangeenda mahali pao.
sw.B: Eli aliwabariki Elkana na mkewe akisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe watoto kwa mwanamke huyu, wachukue nafasi ya yule aliyemwomba na kumtoa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Kisha walirudi nyumbani.
sw.R: Eli aliwabariki Elkana na mkewe. Alimwambia Elkana, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe watoto zaidi kwa mwanamke huyu. Watachukua nafasi ya mtoto aliyemwomba na kumrudisha kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}." Kisha walirudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Hê-li [thường] chúc phước cho Ên-ca-na và vợ ông mà nói: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho ông dòng dõi bởi người đàn bà này thế cho đứa đã được cầu xin, là đứa được xin cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Rồi họ trở về chỗ mình.
vi.B: Hê-li thường chúc phước cho Ên-ca-na và vợ ông: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho ông con cái bởi người đàn bà này, thế cho đứa con bà đã cầu xin và dâng lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Rồi họ trở về nhà.
vi.R: Hê-li thường chúc phước cho Ên-ca-na và vợ ông. Ông nói với Ên-ca-na: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho ông thêm con cái bởi người đàn bà này. Chúng sẽ thế chỗ đứa con bà đã xin rồi dâng lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Rồi họ trở về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리는 엘가나와 그의 아내를 축복하며 말하곤 했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 구하여 바친 그 아이를 대신하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 여자에게서 네게 자손을 주시기를 바란다." 그리고 그들은 자기 곳으로 가곤 했다.
ko.B: 엘리는 엘가나와 그의 아내를 축복하며 말했다. "이 여인이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 구하여 다시 바친 아이를 대신하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 여인에게서 네게 자녀들을 주시기를 빈다." 그러면 그들은 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 엘리는 엘가나와 그의 아내를 축복했다. 엘리는 엘가나에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 여인에게서 네게 자녀를 더 주시기를 빈다. 그 자녀들이 이 여인이 구하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 다시 바친 아이의 자리를 채우기를 바란다." 그러고 나서 그들은 집으로 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: the one asked for: Samuel, asked of God and given to God
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb come from the root sha'al, "ask", which runs through chapter 1: Hannah asked for a son (1:17, 20, 27), and she gave him over to the LORD (1:28, "I have lent him to the LORD"). With "for the LORD", the verb here has the second sense: the one asked for has been dedicated to the LORD.

decisions.choice: who was asked for the LORD: the Hebrew says "he asked"
alternatives: which he lent to the LORD
which you lent to the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb is masculine, "he asked". It may be impersonal ("one asked"), or refer to Elkanah, who agreed to Hannah's vow (1:23). The ancient Greek translation reads "you lent". Hannah is the one who asked and gave (1:27-28), and the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: offspring: children
decisions.reason: The noun means seed, descendants. Eli prays that Hannah will have more children to make up for the son she gave away. Verse 21 tells how the LORD answered.

decisions.choice: to his place: home to Ramah
decisions.reason: "His place" is Elkanah's home as head of the family (verse 11; 1:19).

decisions.choice: she asked for and gave (Balanced); she asked for and gave back (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the asker the subject, as chapter 1 does; Literal keeps the impersonal form. Readable adds that Eli spoke to Elkanah, as "you" in the blessing is singular.

source.text: כִּֽי־פָקַ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־חַנָּ֔ה וַתַּ֛הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־בָנִ֖ים וּשְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת וַיִּגְדַּ֛ל הַנַּ֥עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל עִם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For visited Yahweh Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. And grew the boy Samuel with Yahweh.

en.L: Indeed, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. And the boy Samuel grew up with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Hannah's aid: she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. And all the while the boy Samuel was growing up in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was kind to Hannah. She became pregnant and had three more sons and two daughters. And the boy Samuel grew up there, serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Ciertamente, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} visitó a Ana, y ella concibió y dio a luz tres hijos y dos hijas. Y el niño Samuel creció junto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino en ayuda de Ana: ella concibió y dio a luz tres hijos y dos hijas. Mientras tanto, el niño Samuel crecía en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fue bondadoso con Ana. Ella quedó embarazada y tuvo tres hijos más y dos hijas. Y el niño Samuel creció allí, sirviendo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} visita Anne, et elle conçut et enfanta trois fils et deux filles. Et l’enfant Samuel grandissait auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vint en aide à Anne : elle devint enceinte et mit au monde trois fils et deux filles. Pendant ce temps, le jeune Samuel grandissait en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été bon pour Anne. Elle est tombée enceinte et elle a eu encore trois fils et deux filles. Et le petit Samuel grandissait là-bas, au service {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hakika, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimjia Hana, naye akapata mimba akazaa wana watatu na binti wawili. Na mtoto Samweli akakua pamoja na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamsaidia Hana: akapata mimba, akazaa wana watatu na binti wawili. Wakati huo wote mtoto Samweli alikuwa akikua mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwonea Hana wema. Akapata mimba, akazaa wana watatu zaidi na binti wawili. Na mtoto Samweli alikua huko, akimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thăm viếng An-ne, và bà thụ thai và sinh ba con trai và hai con gái. Còn cậu bé Sa-mu-ên lớn lên bên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đoái thương An-ne: bà thụ thai và sinh thêm ba con trai và hai con gái. Trong khi đó, cậu bé Sa-mu-ên lớn lên trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban ơn cho An-ne. Bà có thai và sinh thêm ba con trai và hai con gái. Còn cậu bé Sa-mu-ên lớn lên tại đó, phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한나를 돌아보셨으니, 그 여자가 임신하여 아들 셋과 딸 둘을 낳았다. 그리고 아이 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 함께 자랐다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한나를 돌보아 주셔서, 한나는 임신하여 아들 셋과 딸 둘을 낳았다. 그동안 아이 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 자랐다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한나에게 은혜를 베푸셨다. 한나는 임신하여 아들 셋과 딸 둘을 더 낳았다. 그리고 어린 사무엘은 그곳에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기며 자랐다.

decisions.choice: for, indeed: the word introduces what followed Eli's blessing
decisions.reason: The word usually means "for" or "because", but here it introduces the outcome of the blessing: indeed, the LORD answered it. The ancient Greek translation has "and".

decisions.choice: visited: came to help
decisions.reason: When God "visits" someone, he pays attention to them and acts, here in kindness, as when he visited Sarah and she conceived (Genesis 21:1).

decisions.choice: with the LORD: at the sanctuary, in the LORD's presence
decisions.reason: Samuel grew up at the house of the LORD in Shiloh, near the ark (3:3).

decisions.choice: came to Hannah's aid (Balanced); was kind to Hannah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "visited". In English that sounds like a social call, so Balanced and Readable say what it meant.

decisions.choice: three more sons (Readable); there, serving the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "more" because these sons were born after Samuel, and says Samuel grew up "there, serving the LORD", which verses 11 and 18 make clear.

source.text: וְעֵלִ֖י זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וְשָׁמַ֗ע אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשׂ֤וּן בָּנָיו֙ לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר־יִשְׁכְּבוּן֙ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים הַצֹּ֣בְא֔וֹת פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And Eli [was] old very, and he heard all that were doing his sons to all Israel, and how they were lying with the women who served [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And Eli [was] very old, and he heard all that his sons were doing to all Israel, and how they were lying with the women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: Eli was now very old. He kept hearing of all that his sons were doing to all Israel, and that they slept with the women serving at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
en.R: Eli was now very old. He heard about everything his sons were doing to the people of Israel. He heard that they were sleeping with the women who served at the entrance of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y Elí [era] muy viejo, y oyó todo lo que sus hijos hacían a todo Israel, y cómo se acostaban con las mujeres que servían a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: Elí era ya muy anciano. Oía una y otra vez todo lo que sus hijos le hacían a todo Israel, y que se acostaban con las mujeres que servían a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: Elí ya era muy anciano. Se enteró de todo lo que sus hijos le estaban haciendo al pueblo de Israel. Supo que se acostaban con las mujeres que servían a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et Éli [était] très vieux, et il entendit tout ce que ses fils faisaient à tout Israël, et comment ils couchaient avec les femmes qui servaient à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Éli était maintenant très vieux. Il entendait parler de tout ce que ses fils faisaient à tout Israël, et du fait qu’ils couchaient avec les femmes qui servaient à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Éli était maintenant très vieux. Il a appris tout ce que ses fils faisaient au peuple d’Israël. Il a appris aussi qu’ils couchaient avec les femmes qui servaient à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na Eli [alikuwa] mzee sana, naye alisikia yote ambayo wanawe walikuwa wakiwatendea Israeli wote, na jinsi walivyokuwa wakilala na wanawake waliohudumu mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Eli sasa alikuwa mzee sana. Aliendelea kusikia yote ambayo wanawe walikuwa wakiwatendea Israeli wote, na kwamba walilala na wanawake waliohudumu mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Eli sasa alikuwa mzee sana. Alisikia habari za mambo yote ambayo wanawe walikuwa wakiwatendea watu wa Israeli. Alisikia kwamba walikuwa wakilala na wanawake waliohudumu kwenye mlango wa hema la kukutania.

vi.L: Hê-li [đã] rất già, và ông nghe mọi điều các con trai ông làm cho cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, và việc chúng nằm với những người đàn bà phục vụ ở cửa lều hội kiến.
vi.B: Hê-li bây giờ đã rất già. Ông cứ nghe nói về mọi việc các con trai ông làm cho cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, và chuyện họ ăn nằm với những người đàn bà phục vụ ở lối vào lều hội kiến.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Hê-li đã rất già. Ông nghe nói về mọi việc các con trai ông làm cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông nghe rằng họ ngủ với những người đàn bà phục vụ ở lối vào lều hội kiến.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리는 매우 늙었다. 그는 자기 아들들이 온 이스라엘에게 하는 모든 일과, 그들이 회막 입구에서 일하는 여자들과 동침한다는 것을 들었다.
ko.B: 엘리는 이제 매우 늙었다. 그는 자기 아들들이 온 이스라엘에게 하는 온갖 일과, 그들이 회막 입구에서 봉사하는 여자들과 잠자리를 같이한다는 소문을 거듭 들었다.
ko.R: 엘리는 이제 아주 늙었다. 엘리는 아들들이 이스라엘 백성에게 하는 일을 모두 들었다. 아들들이 회막 입구에서 일하는 여자들과 잠자리를 같이한다는 것도 들었다.

decisions.choice: the second half of the verse, about the women, is in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The words "and how they were lying with the women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting" are lacking in a Dead Sea Scroll of Samuel and in the main manuscripts of the ancient Greek translation. The Hebrew text, which governs, has them. Reviewers should check this note against the textual evidence.

decisions.choice: the women who served at the entrance: women with some duty at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in Exodus 38:8 for women whose bronze mirrors were made into the basin. What their service was is not known. The sons' sin is worse because it was done at the place of worship.

decisions.choice: he heard: kept hearing
decisions.reason: The verb form suggests that reports kept reaching him, as verses 23-24 say.

decisions.choice: the meeting tent (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the meeting tent" for the tent of meeting, as Exodus and Numbers do.

decisions.choice: Hema la Kukutania (L, B); hema la kukutania (R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note: "Hema la Kukutania", capitalised as a name at Literal and Balanced; Readable writes it in lower case as a description, as the English says "the meeting tent".

decisions.choice: "회막" at every level
decisions.reason: "회막" is the established word for the tent of meeting and the term settled for the Pentateuch, so it is kept at every level; "만남의 장막" would spell out its meaning at Readable but part from the wording used from Exodus on.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם לָ֥מָּה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵיכֶ֣ם רָעִ֔ים מֵאֵ֖ת כָּל־הָעָ֥ם אֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, why are you doing according to things these, that I am hearing your evil dealings from all the people these?

en.L: And he said to them, "Why are you doing things like these? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
en.B: He said to them, "Why are you doing these things? I keep hearing from all the people about the evil you are doing.
en.R: He said to them, "Why are you doing these things? I hear about your evil ways from everyone.

es.L: Y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} cosas como estas? Pues oigo de todo este pueblo {{plural_you:sus malas acciones|vuestras malas acciones}}.
es.B: Él les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} estas cosas? Todo el pueblo me habla del mal que {{plural_you:están haciendo|estáis haciendo}}.
es.R: Les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} estas cosas? Todo el mundo me cuenta lo mal que {{plural_you:se portan|os portáis}}.

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Pourquoi faites-vous des choses pareilles ? Car j’entends parler de vos mauvaises actions par tout ce peuple.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Pourquoi agissez-vous ainsi ? J’entends tout le peuple parler du mal que vous faites.
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « Pourquoi faites-vous ces choses ? Tout le monde me parle de vos mauvaises actions.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnafanya mambo kama haya? Kwa maana nasikia habari za matendo yenu maovu kutoka kwa watu hawa wote.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnafanya mambo haya? Ninaendelea kusikia kutoka kwa watu wote habari za maovu mnayoyatenda.
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnafanya mambo haya? Nasikia kutoka kwa kila mtu habari za njia zenu mbaya.

vi.L: Ông nói với chúng: "Sao các con làm những việc như thế? Vì cha nghe những việc ác của các con từ hết thảy dân này.
vi.B: Ông bảo họ: "Sao các con làm những việc ấy? Cha cứ nghe cả dân chúng nói về những việc ác các con làm.
vi.R: Ông nói với họ: "Sao các con làm những việc như vậy? Cha nghe mọi người nói về những việc xấu xa của các con.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 어찌하여 이런 일들을 하느냐? 내가 이 모든 백성에게서 너희의 악한 행실을 듣고 있다.
ko.B: 그가 아들들에게 말했다. "너희는 어째서 이런 짓을 하느냐? 모든 백성에게서 너희가 저지르는 악한 일을 계속 듣고 있다.
ko.R: 엘리가 아들들에게 말했다. "왜 이런 짓을 하느냐? 너희가 하는 나쁜 짓에 대해 모든 사람에게서 듣고 있다.

decisions.choice: why are you doing such things, that I hear of: one question, which L and B divide
decisions.reason: Hebrew runs on: "why do you do such things as I am hearing, your evil deeds, from all these people?" The question is a rebuke, not a request for information.

decisions.choice: all these people: the worshipers who come to Shiloh
decisions.reason: "These" points to the people around him, those who bring their sacrifices and complain of the sons' treatment.

decisions.choice: a double quotation mark opens here and closes in verse 25
decisions.reason: Eli's words to his sons run through verse 25.

decisions.choice: Eli calls his sons "các con" and himself "cha"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note for parent and child; the father pleads with them.

decisions.choice: Eli speaks to his sons in the plain style (해라체) with "너희"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note sets for parent and child. The quotation opens here and closes in verse 25.

source.text: אַ֖ל בָּנָ֑י כִּ֠י לֽוֹא־טוֹבָ֤ה הַשְּׁמֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י שֹׁמֵ֔עַ מַעֲבִרִ֖ים עַם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: No, my sons, for not good [is] the report which I am hearing; are spreading [it the] people of Yahweh.

en.L: No, my sons! For the report that I am hearing is not good: the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} are spreading [it].
en.B: No, my sons! The report I hear spreading among {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s people is not good.
en.R: Stop this, my sons! I hear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s people saying bad things about you.

es.L: No, hijos míos, porque no [es] buena la fama que oigo: el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [la] está difundiendo.
es.B: ¡No, hijos míos! No es buena la fama que oigo correr entre el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¡Basta ya, hijos míos! Oigo al pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} hablar mal de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Non, mes fils ! Car la rumeur que j’entends n’est pas bonne : le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} la répand.
fr.B: Non, mes fils ! La rumeur que j’entends circuler parmi le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} n’est pas bonne.
fr.R: Arrêtez, mes fils ! J’entends le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dire du mal de vous.

sw.L: Hapana, wanangu! Kwa maana habari ninazozisikia si nzuri: watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wanazieneza.
sw.B: Hapana, wanangu! Habari ninazosikia zikienea kati ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} si nzuri.
sw.R: Acheni hayo, wanangu! Nasikia watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakisema mabaya juu yenu.

vi.L: Không, các con ơi! Vì tiếng đồn mà cha nghe chẳng tốt đẹp gì: dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang loan truyền [nó].
vi.B: Không được đâu, các con ơi! Tiếng đồn cha nghe lan truyền trong dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chẳng tốt đẹp gì.
vi.R: Hãy thôi đi, các con! Cha nghe dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nói những điều xấu về các con.

ko.L: 아니다, 내 아들들아! 내가 듣는 소문이 좋지 않다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성이 [그것을] 퍼뜨리고 있다.
ko.B: 안 된다, 내 아들들아! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성 사이에 퍼지고 있는 소문이 좋지 않구나.
ko.R: 그만두어라, 내 아들들아! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성이 너희를 나쁘게 말하는 것을 내가 듣고 있다.

decisions.choice: the LORD's people are spreading it
alternatives: you are making the LORD's people transgress
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something pass along, here a report passed from person to person. It can also mean "cause to transgress", which would give "you are making the LORD's people sin": their conduct leads the people astray. The verb is plural, and the people are the nearest subject.

decisions.choice: No, my sons: a strong plea to stop
decisions.reason: Eli's "no" breaks off the question with a plea. He rebukes them but does not stop them, which the LORD holds against him (3:13).

decisions.choice: Stop this (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what Eli's "No!" means.

source.text: אִם־יֶחֱטָ֨א אִ֤ישׁ לְאִישׁ֙ וּפִֽלְל֣וֹ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאִ֤ם לַֽיהוָה֙ יֶֽחֱטָא־אִ֔ישׁ מִ֖י יִתְפַּלֶּל־ל֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ לְק֣וֹל אֲבִיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֖ה לַהֲמִיתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If sins a man against a man, will mediate for him God; but if against Yahweh sins a man, who will intercede for him? And not they listened to [the] voice of their father, for desired Yahweh to put them to death.

en.L: If {{gender:a person|a man}} sins against another, God will mediate for {{gender:that person|him}}; but if {{gender:a person|a man}} sins against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who will intercede for {{gender:that person|him}}?" But they would not listen to the voice of their father, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} desired to put them to death.
en.B: If one person sins against another, God can settle the matter; but if someone sins against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who can plead for that person?" But they would not listen to their father, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had decided to put them to death.
en.R: If one person sins against another, God can settle the matter between them. But if someone sins against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who can speak up for them?" Still Eli's sons would not listen to their father, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had already decided to put them to death.

es.L: Si alguien peca contra otro, Dios mediará por él; pero si alguien peca contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿quién intercederá por él?». Pero no escucharon la voz de su padre, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quería hacerlos morir.
es.B: Si una persona peca contra otra, Dios puede arbitrar; pero si alguien peca contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿quién podrá interceder por él?». Pero ellos no quisieron escuchar a su padre, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había decidido darles muerte.
es.R: Si una persona peca contra otra, Dios puede arreglar el asunto entre ellas. Pero si alguien peca contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿quién podrá hablar a su favor?». Aun así, los hijos de Elí no quisieron hacer caso a su padre, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ya había decidido darles muerte.

fr.L: Si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} pèche contre un autre, Dieu sera arbitre pour lui ; mais si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} pèche contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui intercédera pour lui ? » Mais ils n’écoutèrent pas la voix de leur père, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voulait les faire mourir.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un pèche contre un autre, Dieu peut régler l’affaire ; mais si quelqu’un pèche contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui pourra plaider pour lui ? » Mais ils ne voulurent pas écouter leur père, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait décidé de les faire mourir.
fr.R: Si une personne pèche contre une autre, Dieu peut régler l’affaire entre elles. Mais si quelqu’un pèche contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui pourra prendre sa défense ? » Mais les fils d’Éli ne voulaient toujours pas écouter leur père, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait déjà décidé de les faire mourir.

sw.L: Mtu akimtenda mtu mwingine dhambi, Mungu atamsuluhishia; lakini mtu akimtenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhambi, ni nani atakayemwombea?" Lakini hawakuisikiliza sauti ya baba yao, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitaka kuwaua.
sw.B: Mtu mmoja akimkosea mwingine, Mungu anaweza kulisuluhisha jambo hilo; lakini mtu akimkosea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni nani awezaye kumtetea?" Lakini hawakumsikiliza baba yao, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameamua kuwaua.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja akimkosea mwenzake, Mungu anaweza kuwapatanisha. Lakini mtu akimkosea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni nani atakayemtetea?" Hata hivyo wana wa Eli hawakumsikiliza baba yao, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amekwisha kuamua kuwaua.

vi.L: Nếu người này phạm tội với người kia, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ phân xử cho người ấy; nhưng nếu người ta phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì ai sẽ cầu thay cho người ấy?" Nhưng chúng không nghe tiếng của cha mình, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} muốn giết chúng.
vi.B: Nếu người này phạm tội với người kia, Đức Chúa Trời có thể phân xử; nhưng nếu ai phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì ai có thể nài xin cho người ấy?" Nhưng họ không chịu nghe lời cha mình, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định giết họ.
vi.R: Nếu một người phạm tội với người khác, Đức Chúa Trời có thể phân xử giữa họ. Nhưng nếu ai phạm tội với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì ai có thể bênh vực cho người ấy?" Thế nhưng các con trai Hê-li vẫn không chịu nghe lời cha, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã quyết định giết họ.

ko.L: 사람이 사람에게 죄를 지으면 하나님께서 그를 위해 중재하시겠지만, 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지으면 누가 그를 위해 간구하겠느냐?" 그러나 그들은 자기 아버지의 말을 듣지 않았으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 죽이기로 하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 사람이 다른 사람에게 죄를 지으면 하나님께서 그 일을 판가름해 주실 수 있다. 그러나 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지으면, 누가 그를 위해 빌어 줄 수 있겠느냐?" 그러나 그들은 아버지의 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 죽이기로 작정하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 사람끼리 죄를 지으면 하나님께서 그 사이를 바로잡아 주실 수 있다. 그러나 누가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지으면, 누가 그 사람 편을 들어 줄 수 있겠느냐?" 그래도 엘리의 아들들은 아버지의 말을 듣지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이미 그들을 죽이시기로 정하셨기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: God will mediate: God, or judges acting for God
alternatives: the judges will mediate for him
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for God. In some laws it may refer to judges who decide cases before God (Exodus 21:6; 22:7-8), which would give "the judges will settle it". Either way, a wrong done to a person can be settled by a higher authority; a sin against the LORD himself leaves no one above to appeal to.

decisions.choice: mediate, intercede: two forms of one verb
decisions.reason: The first form means to arbitrate or settle a case; the second, the word for praying, means to plead on someone's behalf. It is the verb used for Hannah's prayer (1:10; 2:1).

decisions.choice: the LORD desired to put them to death: their refusal was itself part of his judgment
decisions.reason: Their deafness to their father is not the reason for God's judgment but its sign: their guilt was already settled (verse 34; 3:13-14). Scripture speaks the same way of Pharaoh's hardened heart (Exodus 10:1, 20).

decisions.choice: a person, that person (Literal); one person, someone (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The saying applies to anyone, man or woman. Literal gives the traditional "a man ... him" as the alternative; Balanced and Readable use words that are already inclusive. The quotation that opened in verse 23 closes here.

decisions.choice: {{gender:quelqu'un|un homme}} (Literal); "quelqu’un", "une personne" without a setting (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "a man" means anyone here. The setting goes on the noun at Literal, where French has to choose between "un homme" and "quelqu’un"; Balanced and Readable say "quelqu’un", already inclusive, and the "lui" that refers back to it is ordinary generic French, so no span is needed there, unlike the English "that person|him".

decisions.choice: "alguien", "una persona", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The saying applies to anyone (English r-en-1). Spanish "alguien" and "una persona" already include men and women at every level, so Spanish needs no gender setting here.

decisions.choice: mtu, no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English one
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu" means any person, man or woman, and the verbs do not mark gender, so the English gender span has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: no gender span at Literal: "người này", "người ta", "người ấy"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người" already means a person of either sex, so there is only one natural wording here (Vietnamese style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already means any person, man or woman, so Korean has only one wording here, as the Korean style guide says. Used for the whole block, also for "이스라엘 자손" (2:28).
