records.literal_gloss: And the boy Samuel [was] going and growing and good both with Yahweh and also with men.

en.L: And the boy Samuel kept growing, and [was] good both with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and with people.
en.B: Meanwhile the boy Samuel went on growing up, and both {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the people were pleased with him.
en.R: But the boy Samuel kept growing, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the people liked him more and more.

es.L: Y el niño Samuel iba creciendo, y [era] grato tanto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como a la gente.
es.B: Entretanto, el niño Samuel seguía creciendo, y tanto {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} como la gente estaban contentos con él.
es.R: Pero el niño Samuel seguía creciendo, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y la gente lo querían cada vez más.

fr.L: Et l’enfant Samuel allait grandissant, et [il était] bon aussi bien auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’auprès des {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.B: Pendant ce temps, le jeune Samuel continuait de grandir, et il plaisait à {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme aux gens.
fr.R: Le petit Samuel continuait à grandir, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et les gens l’aimaient de plus en plus.

sw.L: Na mtoto Samweli akaendelea kukua, na [akawa] mwema mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na mbele ya watu pia.
sw.B: Wakati huo mtoto Samweli aliendelea kukua, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na watu wakapendezwa naye.
sw.R: Lakini mtoto Samweli aliendelea kukua, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na watu wakazidi kumpenda.

vi.L: Còn cậu bé Sa-mu-ên cứ lớn lên, và [được] đẹp lòng cả {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lẫn loài người.
vi.B: Trong khi đó, cậu bé Sa-mu-ên tiếp tục lớn lên, và được đẹp lòng cả {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lẫn mọi người.
vi.R: Còn cậu bé Sa-mu-ên cứ lớn lên, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cùng mọi người càng ngày càng thương mến cậu.

ko.L: 그리고 아이 사무엘은 점점 자라 갔고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께도 사람들에게도 좋게 [여겨졌다].
ko.B: 한편 아이 사무엘은 점점 자라면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 사람들에게 더욱 사랑을 받았다.
ko.R: 그러나 어린 사무엘은 계속 자랐고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 사람들은 사무엘을 점점 더 좋아하게 되었다.

decisions.choice: was going and growing and good: grew steadily in size and in favor
decisions.reason: "Going" with another verb means "more and more". "Good with" someone means pleasing to them, in favor with them.

decisions.choice: in favor with the LORD and with people
decisions.reason: Luke uses almost the same words of the boy Jesus: he grew "in favor with God and people" (Luke 2:52; compare 2:40).

decisions.choice: and the boy Samuel: again set against Eli's sons
decisions.reason: Each picture of the sons' evil is followed by one of Samuel growing (verses 11, 18, 21).

decisions.choice: were pleased with him (Balanced); liked him more and more (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "good with" means. Readable keeps the sense of growing favor in "more and more".

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־עֵלִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲנִגְלֹ֤ה נִגְלֵ֨יתִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְבֵ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came a man of God to Eli and said to him, thus says Yahweh: did I indeed reveal myself to [the] house of your father in their being in Egypt, to [the] house of Pharaoh?

en.L: And a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'Did I [not] indeed reveal {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} to the house of your father when they were in Egypt, [subject] to the house of Pharaoh?
en.B: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'Did I not plainly reveal {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} to your ancestor's family when they were in Egypt, subject to Pharaoh's house?
en.R: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: 'I showed {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} to your ancestors when they were in Egypt as slaves of Pharaoh.

es.L: Y un hombre de Dios vino a Elí y le dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “¿No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} revelé yo claramente a la casa de tu padre cuando estaban en Egipto, [sometidos] a la casa del faraón?
es.B: Un hombre de Dios vino a Elí y le dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: “¿Acaso no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} di a conocer claramente a la familia de tu antepasado cuando estaban en Egipto, sometidos a la casa del faraón?
es.R: Un hombre de Dios vino a Elí y le dijo: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Yo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mostré a tus antepasados cuando eran esclavos del faraón en Egipto.

fr.L: Et un homme de Dieu vint vers Éli et lui dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis-je pas vraiment révélé à la maison de ton père, quand ils étaient en Égypte, [soumis] à la maison de Pharaon ?
fr.B: Un homme de Dieu vint trouver Éli et lui dit : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis-je pas clairement révélé à la famille de ton ancêtre, quand elle était en Égypte, soumise à la maison de Pharaon ?
fr.R: Un homme de Dieu est venu voir Éli et lui a dit : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suis montré à tes ancêtres quand ils étaient en Égypte, esclaves de Pharaon.

sw.L: Na mtu wa Mungu akamjia Eli, akamwambia, "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: 'Je, [si] kweli nilijifunua kwa nyumba ya baba yako walipokuwa Misri, [chini ya] nyumba ya Farao?
sw.B: Mtu wa Mungu akamjia Eli, akamwambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: 'Je, sikujifunua waziwazi kwa jamaa ya babu yako walipokuwa Misri, chini ya nyumba ya Farao?
sw.R: Mtu wa Mungu alimjia Eli, akamwambia, "Hiki ndicho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema: 'Nilijionyesha kwa babu zako walipokuwa watumwa wa Farao huko Misri.

vi.L: Có một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến cùng Hê-li và nói với ông: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thật tỏ mình ra cho nhà cha ngươi khi họ còn ở Ai Cập, [làm nô lệ] cho nhà Pha-ra-ôn sao?
vi.B: Một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến gặp Hê-li và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tỏ mình rõ ràng cho gia đình tổ phụ ngươi khi họ còn ở Ai Cập, phục dịch nhà Pha-ra-ôn sao?
vi.R: Một người của Đức Chúa Trời đến gặp Hê-li và nói: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Ta đã tỏ mình ra cho tổ tiên ngươi khi họ còn làm nô lệ cho Pha-ra-ôn ở Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 사람이 엘리에게 와서 그에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. '네 조상의 집이 이집트에서 바로의 집에 [속해] 있을 때, 내가 참으로 그들에게 나 자신을 드러내지 [않았느냐]?
ko.B: 하나님의 사람이 엘리에게 와서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. '네 조상의 집안이 이집트에서 바로의 집에 매여 있을 때, 내가 분명히 그들에게 나를 드러내지 않았느냐?
ko.R: 하나님의 사람이 엘리에게 와서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. '네 조상들이 이집트에서 바로의 종으로 있을 때, 내가 그들에게 나를 나타내 보였다.

decisions.choice: a man of God: a prophet, here unnamed
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks for God (Judges 13:6; 1 Kings 13:1; 2 Kings 4:9). This one is not named; what matters is his message.

decisions.choice: did I indeed reveal myself?: a question expecting the answer yes
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. The question is a reminder, not a request: of course God showed himself to them. The ancient Greek translation has a statement instead of a question; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the house of your father: the priestly family from which Eli came
decisions.reason: Eli's ancestor is not named. Most likely the house of Aaron, chosen as priests in Egypt and the wilderness (Exodus 4:14-16, 27; 28:1); it could also be the tribe of Levi as a whole.

decisions.choice: in Egypt, to the house of Pharaoh: under Pharaoh's rule, as his slaves
decisions.reason: "To the house of Pharaoh" means belonging to it, subject to it. The ancient Greek translation adds "slaves".

decisions.choice: the man of God's words open with a double quotation mark; the LORD's words inside them take single quotes
decisions.reason: The man of God speaks from here to the end of verse 36, and what he speaks is the LORD's message. Words the LORD quotes inside it (verses 30, 36) take double quotes again. Literal says "Thus says the LORD", Balanced "The LORD says this" and Readable "This is what the LORD says", as throughout Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question that expects "yes" into a statement, and says "slaves", which is what being subject to Pharaoh's house meant (Exodus 1:13-14).

decisions.choice: the man of God's words in « », the LORD's words inside them in “ ”, and the words quoted inside those in ‘ ’ (verse 30, verse 36)
decisions.reason: The French marks for a quotation inside a quotation, as the style guide sets. The quotations close together at the end of verse 36.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR" (L); "El SEÑOR dice esto" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R); the prophet's words in «», the LORD's words inside them in “ ”, and words quoted inside those in ‘ ’
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel: the messenger formula takes one wording at each level, as the Samuel terms note gives it for English. Spanish narrative uses «» for speech, “ ” inside and ‘ ’ inside those, as the Pentateuch drafts; the nested quotations close together at the end of verse 36.

decisions.choice: mtu wa Mungu
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "mtu wa Mungu" at every level. The man of God's words take double quotes and the LORD's words inside them single quotes, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo BWANA (L); BWANA asema hivi (B); Hiki ndicho BWANA anachosema (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula "thus says the LORD" has one fixed wording at each level for the whole book, following the three English wordings.

decisions.choice: God speaks as "Ta" and calls Eli "ngươi"; "người của Đức Chúa Trời" for "a man of God"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for "man of God"; God speaks in judgment, so the Genesis note's "ngươi" fits better than "con".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "하시는 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the prophetic formula, as the Samuel terms note sets for "Thus says the LORD"; God's words inside take single quotes. Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Eli in the plain style (해라체) with "나" and "너"
decisions.reason: As the Korean notes set for God speaking.

source.text: וּבָחֹ֣ר אֹ֠תוֹ מִכָּל־שִׁבְטֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לִי֙ לְכֹהֵ֔ן לַעֲל֣וֹת עַֽל־מִזְבְּחִ֗י לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֛רֶת לָשֵׂ֥את אֵפ֖וֹד לְפָנָ֑י וָֽאֶתְּנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ אֶת־כָּל־אִשֵּׁ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [did I] choose him from all [the] tribes of Israel for myself as priest, to go up on my altar, to make smoke [of] incense, to carry an ephod before me? And I gave to [the] house of your father all [the] fire offerings of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And [did I not] choose him out of all the tribes of Israel for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} as priest, to go up on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, to burn incense, to carry an ephod before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? And I gave to the house of your father all the offerings by fire of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: Out of all the tribes of Israel, did I not choose him as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} priest, to go up to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, to offer incense, and to wear an ephod before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? And I gave your ancestor's family all the food offerings of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: I chose your ancestor out of all the tribes of Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} priest. He was to offer sacrifices on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, burn incense, and wear the ephod to serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I gave your family a share of all the food offerings the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} burned on the fire.

es.L: ¿Y no lo escogí de entre todas las tribus de Israel para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como sacerdote, para subir a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, para quemar incienso, para llevar el efod delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Y di a la casa de tu padre todas las ofrendas quemadas de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: De entre todas las tribus de Israel, ¿no lo escogí yo para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacerdote, subiera a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, quemara incienso y llevara el efod delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? Y a la familia de tu antepasado le di todas las ofrendas quemadas de los israelitas.
es.R: Escogí a tu antepasado de entre todas las tribus de Israel para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacerdote. Él debía ofrecer sacrificios en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, quemar incienso y llevar el efod a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} servicio. A tu familia le di una parte de todas las ofrendas que los israelitas quemaban en el fuego.

fr.L: Et [ne] l’ai-je [pas] choisi d’entre toutes les tribus d’Israël pour [être] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} prêtre, pour monter à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, pour faire fumer l’encens, pour porter l’éphod devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Et j’ai donné à la maison de ton père toutes les offrandes consumées par le feu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Ne l’ai-je pas choisi parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} prêtre, pour monter à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, pour offrir l’encens et pour porter l’éphod devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Et j’ai donné à la famille de ton ancêtre toutes les offrandes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} consument par le feu.
fr.R: J’ai choisi ton ancêtre parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} prêtre. Il devait offrir des sacrifices sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, brûler de l’encens et porter l’éphod pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servir. J’ai donné à ta famille une part de toutes les offrandes que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} brûlaient sur le feu.

sw.L: Na je, [sikumchagua] yeye kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa kuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, apande juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, afukize uvumba, avae efodi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Nami nikaipa nyumba ya baba yako sadaka zote za kuteketezwa kwa moto za wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Je, sikumchagua kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli awe kuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, apande juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, afukize uvumba na kuvaa efodi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Nami nikaipa jamaa ya babu yako sadaka zote za chakula za Waisraeli.
sw.R: Nilimchagua babu yako kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli awe kuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Alipaswa kutoa dhabihu juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kufukiza uvumba, na kuvaa efodi ili anitumikie. Niliipa jamaa yako sehemu ya sadaka zote za chakula ambazo Waisraeli waliziteketeza kwa moto.

vi.L: [Chẳng phải] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn người ấy trong mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên làm thầy tế lễ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để đi lên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đốt hương, và mang áo ê-phót trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [sao]? Ta đã ban cho nhà cha ngươi mọi lễ vật dùng lửa dâng lên của con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn người ấy trong mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên làm thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để lên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dâng hương và mặc áo ê-phót trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? Ta cũng đã ban cho gia đình tổ phụ ngươi mọi lễ vật thực phẩm của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ta đã chọn tổ tiên ngươi trong mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên làm thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người phải dâng sinh tế trên bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đốt hương, và mặc áo ê-phót để phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta đã cho gia đình ngươi một phần trong mọi lễ vật thực phẩm mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đốt trên lửa.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 그를 택하여 내 제사장으로 삼아, 내 제단에 올라가고 향을 피우며 내 앞에서 에봇을 입게 하지 [않았느냐]? 그리고 내가 이스라엘 자손이 불로 드리는 모든 제물을 네 조상의 집에 주었다.
ko.B: 내가 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 그를 택하여 내 제사장으로 삼고, 내 제단에 올라가 향을 피우며 내 앞에서 에봇을 입게 하지 않았느냐? 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 바치는 화제물을 모두 네 조상의 집안에 주었다.
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 네 조상을 내 제사장으로 뽑았다. 그는 내 제단에서 제물을 바치고, 향을 피우고, 에봇을 입고 나를 섬겨야 했다. 그리고 나는 이스라엘 자손이 불에 태워 바치는 제물의 몫을 네 집안에 주었다.

decisions.choice: go up to the altar, burn incense, carry an ephod: the three tasks of the priest
decisions.reason: Only priests could offer on the altar (Numbers 18:7), burn incense before the LORD (Exodus 30:7-8) and carry the ephod with the Urim and Thummim, through which they sought God's answers (Exodus 28:30; 1 Samuel 14:3; 23:9).

decisions.choice: fire offerings: the offerings burned on the altar, from which the priests received their share
decisions.reason: The word names offerings made by fire. The priests and their families lived from their portion of these offerings (Leviticus 2:3; 7:34-35; Numbers 18:8-10; Deuteronomy 18:1). Eli's sons had all they needed, yet took more.

decisions.choice: did I not choose: the question of verse 27 continues
decisions.reason: The verb continues the form of the question in verse 27. God reminds Eli of everything he has given his family.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 27, Readable makes the question a statement. It says "offer sacrifices on my altar" for "go up on my altar", and "a share of" the offerings, which is what the priests were given.

decisions.choice: offerings by fire (Literal); food offerings (Balanced); food offerings burned on the fire (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 3.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as in the Pentateuch: Spanish "hijos" already takes in daughters, so "los hijos de Israel" is inclusive and needs no setting; Balanced and Readable say "los israelitas".

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (L); Waisraeli (B, R)
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note: "wana wa Israeli" at Literal and "Waisraeli" at Balanced and Readable, with no span, since Swahili has no second wording to offer. God's "my" and "me" are free pronouns here and take the deity pronoun span.

decisions.choice: no gender span for "sons of Israel": "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L), "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "con cháu" and "dân" already include everyone, so Vietnamese has no second wording to offer; Literal keeps the picture of descent. God speaking says "Ta", with the deity pronoun span in the middle of a sentence, as the Genesis terms note sets.

source.text: לָ֣מָּה תִבְעֲט֗וּ בְּזִבְחִי֙ וּבְמִנְחָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי מָע֑וֹן וַתְּכַבֵּ֤ד אֶת־בָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נִּי לְהַבְרִֽיאֲכֶ֗ם מֵרֵאשִׁ֛ית כָּל־מִנְחַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering which I commanded [in my] dwelling, and you honor your sons more than me, by making yourselves fat from [the] best of every offering of Israel, of my people?

en.L: Why do you [all] kick at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sacrifice and at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} offering, which I commanded [for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}}] dwelling, and [why do] you honor your sons more than {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, making yourselves fat on the best of every offering of Israel {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people?
en.B: Why do you kick at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sacrifices and offerings, which I commanded for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, fattening yourselves on the best parts of every offering made by Israel, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people?
en.R: So why do you treat {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sacrifices and offerings with such disrespect? I commanded them for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house. Why do you honor your sons more than you honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? You make yourselves fat on the best parts of every offering {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel bring.

es.L: ¿Por qué {{plural_you:dan coces|dais coces}} contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sacrificio y contra {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ofrenda, que yo mandé [para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}}] morada, y [por qué] honras a tus hijos más que a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:engordándose|engordándoos}} con lo mejor de toda ofrenda de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo?
es.B: ¿Por qué {{plural_you:dan coces|dais coces}} contra {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sacrificios y ofrendas, que ordené para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} morada? ¿Por qué honras a tus hijos más que a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:engordándose|engordándoos}} con lo mejor de cada ofrenda de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo?
es.R: ¿Por qué, entonces, {{plural_you:tratan|tratáis}} con tanto desprecio {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sacrificios y ofrendas? Yo los ordené para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa. ¿Por qué honras a tus hijos más que a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? {{plural_you:Ustedes engordan|Vosotros engordáis}} con lo mejor de todas las ofrendas que trae {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: Pourquoi foulez-vous du pied {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sacrifice et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} offrande, que j’ai ordonnés [pour {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}}] demeure, et honores-tu tes fils plus que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, en vous engraissant du meilleur de toutes les offrandes d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ?
fr.B: Pourquoi traitez-vous à coups de pied {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sacrifices et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} offrandes, que j’ai prescrits pour {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} demeure ? Pourquoi honores-tu tes fils plus que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, en vous engraissant de la meilleure part de chaque offrande d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ?
fr.R: Alors pourquoi méprisez-vous ainsi {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sacrifices et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} offrandes ? Je les ai ordonnés pour {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison. Pourquoi honores-tu tes fils plus que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Vous vous engraissez avec les meilleurs morceaux de toutes les offrandes que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël apporte.

sw.L: Kwa nini [ninyi] mnaipiga teke dhabihu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na sadaka {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, niliyoiamuru [kwa ajili ya] maskani [{{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}], nawe unawaheshimu wanao kuliko {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, mkijinenepesha kwa vilivyo bora vya kila sadaka ya Israeli watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}?
sw.B: Kwa nini mnazipiga teke dhabihu na sadaka {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, nilizoziamuru kwa ajili ya maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}? Kwa nini unawaheshimu wanao kuliko {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, mkijinenepesha kwa sehemu bora za kila sadaka inayotolewa na Israeli, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}?
sw.R: Basi kwa nini mnazidharau dhabihu na sadaka {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} hivi? Niliziamuru kwa ajili ya nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Kwa nini unawaheshimu wanao kuliko unavyoniheshimu? Mnajinenepesha kwa sehemu bora za kila sadaka wanayoileta watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

vi.L: Sao các ngươi đá vào sinh tế của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và lễ vật của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là những thứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền [cho] nơi ngự [của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}], và ngươi tôn trọng các con trai ngươi hơn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, làm cho các ngươi béo mập bằng phần ngon nhất của mọi lễ vật của Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.B: Sao các ngươi đá vào sinh tế và lễ vật của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là những thứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền dâng tại nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? Sao ngươi tôn trọng các con trai ngươi hơn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để các ngươi béo mập nhờ phần ngon nhất của mọi lễ vật mà Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dâng lên?
vi.R: Vậy sao các ngươi coi thường sinh tế và lễ vật của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như thế? Ta đã truyền dâng những thứ ấy tại nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Sao ngươi tôn trọng các con trai ngươi hơn tôn trọng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? Các ngươi tự làm cho mình béo mập bằng những phần ngon nhất của mọi lễ vật mà Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dâng lên.

ko.L: 어찌하여 너희는 내가 [내] 처소에서 명령한 내 제사와 내 예물을 발로 차며, 내 백성 이스라엘의 모든 예물 가운데 가장 좋은 것으로 너희 자신을 살찌우면서 네 아들들을 나보다 더 존중하느냐?
ko.B: 어찌하여 너희는 내 처소를 위해 내가 명령한 제사와 예물을 발로 차느냐? 어찌하여 너는 내 백성 이스라엘이 바치는 모든 예물 가운데 가장 좋은 부분으로 너희 배를 불리면서, 네 아들들을 나보다 더 존중하느냐?
ko.R: 그런데 어찌하여 너희는 내 집을 위해 내가 명령한 제사와 예물을 그렇게 업신여기느냐? 어찌하여 너는 나보다 네 아들들을 더 존중하느냐? 너희는 내 백성 이스라엘이 바치는 모든 제물 가운데 가장 좋은 부분으로 너희 배를 불리고 있다.

decisions.choice: kick at: treat with scorn, like a stubborn animal kicking
decisions.reason: The verb is used only here and in Deuteronomy 32:15, where Israel "grew fat and kicked". Here too the kicking goes with growing fat: Eli's house scorns the offerings while feeding on them.

decisions.choice: dwelling: the Hebrew word is hard to explain here
alternatives: which I commanded, with a greedy eye
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "which I commanded, dwelling", most likely meaning the offerings God commanded for his dwelling, the sanctuary. The ancient Greek translation read a different text, "with a greedy eye". The word returns, just as hard, in verse 32. Reviewers should check this note against the textual evidence.

decisions.choice: you kick (plural), you honor (singular): Eli shares his sons' guilt
decisions.reason: "Kick" is plural, including Eli with his sons; "honor" is singular, aimed at Eli himself. By letting his sons go on and eating with them ("making yourselves fat"), Eli has put them before God. He is called heavy in 4:18.

decisions.choice: sacrifice and offering: all the gifts brought to God
decisions.reason: The pair zevach (an animal sacrifice) and minchah (an offering or gift) together stand for every kind of offering.

decisions.choice: kick at (Literal, Balanced); treat with disrespect (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the vivid picture, which links this verse to Deuteronomy 32:15. Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "vous" for "kick" and for "fattening yourselves", "tu" for "honor"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew switches between plural and singular: Eli and his sons kick at the offerings, Eli honors his sons (m3). French has the same distinction and keeps it at every level; the English cannot show it.

decisions.choice: "traitez-vous à coups de pied"
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of a stubborn animal kicking (m1) where French can say it plainly; Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: plural "{{plural_you:dan coces|dais coces}}", "{{plural_you:engordándose|engordándoos}}"; singular "honras"
decisions.reason: Spanish can show what English cannot: the Hebrew "kick" and "make yourselves fat" are plural, Eli with his sons, while "you honor" is singular, Eli alone (m3). Each level keeps the Hebrew number, with the plural under the plural-you setting.

decisions.choice: mnaipiga teke (plural), unawaheshimu (singular)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural "you kick" to singular "you honour" (m3); Swahili marks number in the verb, so it keeps the turn at every level without brackets.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" where the Hebrew verb is plural, "ngươi" where it is singular
decisions.reason: Eli shares his sons' guilt (meaning decision); Vietnamese can keep the switch the Hebrew makes, at every level.

decisions.choice: "너희는 ... 발로 차며" (plural) and "네 아들들을 ... 존중하느냐" (singular)
decisions.reason: Korean can keep the Hebrew's change from plural to singular (m3) with "너희" and "너", so Eli's share in his sons' guilt stays visible.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻם־יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אָמ֣וֹר אָמַ֔רְתִּי בֵּֽיתְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ יִתְהַלְּכ֥וּ לְפָנַ֖י עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְעַתָּ֤ה נְאֻם־יְהוָה֙ חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י כִּֽי־מְכַבְּדַ֥י אֲכַבֵּ֖ד וּבֹזַ֥י יֵקָֽלּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore declaration of Yahweh, God of Israel: indeed I said, your house and [the] house of your father will walk before me until forever; but now declaration of Yahweh: far be it from me, for those honoring me I will honor, and those despising me will be lightly esteemed.

en.L: Therefore, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, I did indeed say, "Your house and the house of your father will walk before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} forever"; but now, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, far be it from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! For those who honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} I will honor, and those who despise {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will be lightly esteemed.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, declares: I did promise that your family and your ancestor's family would walk before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} forever. But now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} declares: That will never be! For I will honor those who honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and those who despise {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will be treated as nothing.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says: I promised that your family would serve before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests forever. But now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I will never let that happen! I will honor people who honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. But people who despise {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will be treated as worthless.

es.L: Por tanto, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: Yo ciertamente dije: ‘Tu casa y la casa de tu padre andarán delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para siempre’; pero ahora declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: ¡Lejos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}! Porque a los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honran honraré, y los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desprecian serán tenidos en poco.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, declara: Yo prometí que tu familia y la familia de tu antepasado andarían delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para siempre. Pero ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} declara: ¡De ningún modo! Porque honraré a los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honran, y los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desprecian serán tenidos por nada.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: Yo prometí que tu familia {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} serviría como sacerdotes para siempre. Pero ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: ¡Nunca permitiré que eso suceda! Honraré a los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honran. Pero los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desprecian serán tratados como gente sin valor.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, j’avais bien dit : ‘Ta maison et la maison de ton père marcheront devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour toujours’ ; mais maintenant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Car ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honorent, je les honorerai, et ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} méprisent seront tenus pour peu de chose.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, déclare : J’avais bien promis que ta famille et la famille de ton ancêtre marcheraient devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour toujours. Mais maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare : Il n’en sera jamais ainsi ! Car j’honorerai ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honorent, et ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} méprisent ne compteront pour rien.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : J’avais promis que ta famille {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servirait comme prêtres pour toujours. Mais maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Je ne laisserai jamais faire cela ! J’honorerai ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honorent. Mais ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} méprisent seront traités comme des gens sans valeur.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, hakika nilisema, 'Nyumba yako na nyumba ya baba yako zitatembea mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} milele'; lakini sasa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hilo na liwe mbali {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}! Kwa maana wale wanaoniheshimu nitawaheshimu, na wale wanaonidharau watahesabiwa kuwa duni.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema: Kweli niliahidi kwamba jamaa yako na jamaa ya babu yako wangetembea mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} milele. Lakini sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema: Hilo halitakuwa kamwe! Kwa maana nitawaheshimu wanaoniheshimu, na wanaonidharau watahesabiwa kuwa si kitu.
sw.R: Basi hiki ndicho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, anachosema: Niliahidi kwamba jamaa yako ingenitumikia kama makuhani milele. Lakini sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema: Sitaruhusu hilo litokee kamwe! Nitawaheshimu watu wanaoniheshimu. Lakini watu wanaonidharau watahesabiwa kuwa hawana thamani.

vi.L: Vì vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Ta thật đã nói: 'Nhà ngươi và nhà cha ngươi sẽ bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi'; nhưng bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta quyết không để như vậy! Vì ai tôn trọng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tôn trọng, còn ai khinh dể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị xem nhẹ.
vi.B: Vì vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Ta đã hứa rằng gia đình ngươi và gia đình tổ phụ ngươi sẽ bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi. Nhưng bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Không bao giờ có chuyện đó! Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tôn trọng người tôn trọng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, còn kẻ khinh dể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị coi như không.
vi.R: Vì vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Ta đã hứa rằng gia đình ngươi sẽ làm thầy tế lễ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi. Nhưng bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta sẽ không bao giờ để điều đó xảy ra! Ta sẽ tôn trọng những ai tôn trọng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Còn những ai khinh dể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị coi là vô giá trị.

ko.L: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 참으로 네 집과 네 조상의 집이 영원히 내 앞에서 다닐 것이라고 말했다. 그러나 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 결코 그럴 수 없다! 나를 존중하는 자들을 내가 존중하고, 나를 멸시하는 자들은 가볍게 여겨질 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 분명히 네 집안과 네 조상의 집안이 영원히 내 앞에서 살아가게 하겠다고 약속했다. 그러나 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 결코 그렇게 되지 않을 것이다! 나를 존중하는 자를 내가 존중하고, 나를 멸시하는 자는 업신여김을 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 네 집안이 영원히 내 앞에서 제사장으로 섬길 것이라고 약속했다. 그러나 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 절대로 그렇게 두지 않겠다! 나를 존중하는 사람은 내가 존중할 것이다. 그러나 나를 멸시하는 사람은 하찮게 여김을 받을 것이다.

decisions.choice: walk before me: live and serve in my presence
decisions.reason: To walk before God is to live in his sight and serve him. Here it means serving as priests at his sanctuary.

decisions.choice: I did say ... but now far be it from me: a promise withdrawn
decisions.reason: God had promised the priesthood to Aaron's line forever (Exodus 29:9; compare Numbers 25:13). That promise still stands for the priesthood, but this branch of the family loses it because it has despised him (verse 35; 1 Kings 2:27).

decisions.choice: far be it from me: an emphatic refusal
decisions.reason: The phrase rejects something as unthinkable. God will not keep honoring a house that dishonors him.

decisions.choice: honor, lightly esteemed: heavy and light
decisions.reason: The verb "honor" comes from the word for "heavy", giving weight; "lightly esteemed" is from the word for "light". Those who give God weight he will give weight; those who make light of him will count for nothing.

decisions.choice: I did promise that ... (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal quotes God's earlier words. Balanced and Readable report them as a promise, which they were, and so need no further quotation marks. "Declares the LORD" follows the wording used throughout Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: serve before me as priests (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what walking before God meant for Eli's family, and folds "the house of your father" into "your family".

decisions.choice: asema BWANA (L, B); anasema BWANA (R)
decisions.reason: "Declares the LORD" is "asema BWANA" at Literal and Balanced and the plain "anasema" at Readable, as the English moves from "declares" to "says". A promise quoted inside the LORD's words takes single quotes at Literal, where the English quotes it.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks for the words God once said, inside the man of God's speech
alternatives: double quotation marks, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: The LORD's words are already inside the double quotation that opened in verse 27, so the promise he quotes takes the next level of quotation marks in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God is speaking of himself, so Balanced and Readable drop the honorific, as God's own words in the plain style; Literal keeps the Hebrew noun "declaration". One wording for "declares the LORD" through the block.

source.text: הִנֵּה֙ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וְגָֽדַעְתִּי֙ אֶת־זְרֹ֣עֲךָ֔ וְאֶת־זְרֹ֖עַ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ מִֽהְי֥וֹת זָקֵ֖ן בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, and I will cut off your arm and [the] arm of [the] house of your father, from being an old man in your house.

en.L: Look, days are coming when I will cut off your arm and the arm of the house of your father, so that there will not be an old man in your house.
en.B: The time is coming when I will break your strength and the strength of your ancestor's family, so that no one in your family will live to old age.
en.R: A time is coming when I will break the strength of your family. No one in your family will live to be old.

es.L: Mira, vienen días en que cortaré tu brazo y el brazo de la casa de tu padre, de modo que no haya anciano en tu casa.
es.B: Llega el tiempo en que quebraré tu fuerza y la fuerza de la familia de tu antepasado, de modo que nadie en tu familia llegará a viejo.
es.R: Llega un tiempo en que acabaré con la fuerza de tu familia. Nadie en tu familia llegará a viejo.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent où je couperai ton bras et le bras de la maison de ton père, pour qu’il n’y ait plus de vieillard dans ta maison.
fr.B: Le temps vient où je briserai ta force et la force de la famille de ton ancêtre, si bien que personne dans ta famille n’atteindra la vieillesse.
fr.R: Le moment vient où je briserai la force de ta famille. Personne dans ta famille ne vivra jusqu’à la vieillesse.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja nitakapoukata mkono wako na mkono wa nyumba ya baba yako, ili pasiwe na mzee katika nyumba yako.
sw.B: Wakati unakuja nitakapozivunja nguvu zako na nguvu za jamaa ya babu yako, ili mtu yeyote katika jamaa yako asiishi mpaka uzee.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja nitakapozivunja nguvu za jamaa yako. Hakuna mtu katika jamaa yako atakayeishi mpaka kuwa mzee.

vi.L: Kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chặt cánh tay ngươi và cánh tay của nhà cha ngươi, đến nỗi trong nhà ngươi sẽ không có người già.
vi.B: Sắp đến lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bẻ gãy sức mạnh của ngươi và của gia đình tổ phụ ngươi, đến nỗi trong gia đình ngươi sẽ chẳng ai sống đến tuổi già.
vi.R: Sắp đến lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bẻ gãy sức mạnh của gia đình ngươi. Trong gia đình ngươi sẽ không ai sống đến tuổi già.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 오고 있다. 내가 네 팔과 네 조상의 집의 팔을 끊어, 네 집에 노인이 없게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 때가 오고 있다. 내가 네 힘과 네 조상 집안의 힘을 꺾어, 네 집안에서 아무도 늙도록 살지 못하게 하겠다.
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. 그때 내가 네 집안의 힘을 꺾어 버리겠다. 네 집안에서는 아무도 늙을 때까지 살지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: arm: strength
decisions.reason: The arm stands for a person's strength and power. To cut off the arm is to break the family's strength.

decisions.choice: no old man in your house: all will die before they grow old
decisions.reason: The men of Eli's family will die young. The slaughter of the priests of Nob, Eli's descendants, is the first great fulfillment (22:16-19).

decisions.choice: strength (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "arm". Balanced and Readable give its sense. "Look" stands for the word often rendered "behold"; Balanced and Readable leave it out and let "the time is coming" carry the stress.

source.text: וְהִבַּטְתָּ֙ צַ֣ר מָע֔וֹן בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵיטִ֖יב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה זָקֵ֛ן בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will look on distress of dwelling in all that he will do good to Israel; and not will be an old man in your house all the days.

en.L: And you will look on [the] distress of [{{deity_pronoun:my|My}}] dwelling, in all the good that will be done for Israel; and there will not be an old man in your house all the days.
en.B: In {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dwelling you will see distress, even while Israel is given every good thing, and no one in your family will ever live to old age.
en.R: You will see trouble come on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house, even while good things are done for the rest of Israel. And no one in your family will ever grow old.

es.L: Y verás la angustia de [{{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}}] morada, en todo el bien que se hará a Israel; y no habrá anciano en tu casa todos los días.
es.B: Verás angustia en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} morada, aun mientras Israel recibe toda clase de bienes, y nadie en tu familia llegará jamás a viejo.
es.R: Verás llegar la desgracia sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, aun mientras se hace el bien al resto de Israel. Y nadie en tu familia llegará nunca a viejo.

fr.L: Et tu verras la détresse de [{{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}}] demeure, dans tout le bien qui sera fait à Israël ; et il n’y aura pas de vieillard dans ta maison, tous les jours.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} demeure tu verras la détresse, alors même qu’Israël recevra toutes sortes de biens, et personne dans ta famille n’atteindra jamais la vieillesse.
fr.R: Tu verras le malheur venir sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, alors même que le reste d’Israël recevra du bien. Et dans ta famille, plus personne ne deviendra vieux.

sw.L: Nawe utaiona dhiki ya maskani [{{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}], katika mema yote yatakayotendewa Israeli; wala hapatakuwa na mzee katika nyumba yako siku zote.
sw.B: Utaona dhiki katika maskani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, hata wakati Israeli inapopewa kila jambo jema, na hakuna mtu katika jamaa yako atakayeishi mpaka uzee kamwe.
sw.R: Utaona taabu ikiijia nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, hata wakati mambo mema yanatendewa Waisraeli wengine. Na hakuna mtu katika jamaa yako atakayezeeka kamwe.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ nhìn thấy cảnh khốn quẫn của nơi ngự [của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}], trong mọi điều tốt lành sẽ được ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên; và trong nhà ngươi sẽ không bao giờ có người già.
vi.B: Tại nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, ngươi sẽ thấy cảnh khốn quẫn, ngay khi Y-sơ-ra-ên được ban mọi điều tốt lành, và trong gia đình ngươi sẽ chẳng bao giờ có ai sống đến tuổi già.
vi.R: Ngươi sẽ thấy tai họa đến trên nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, ngay trong khi những người khác trong Y-sơ-ra-ên được ban cho những điều tốt lành. Và trong gia đình ngươi sẽ không bao giờ có ai sống đến tuổi già.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘에게 베풀어질 모든 좋은 일 가운데서, 너는 [내] 처소의 고난을 볼 것이다. 그리고 네 집에는 언제까지나 노인이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘이 온갖 좋은 것을 받는 동안에도 너는 내 처소에 닥친 고난을 볼 것이다. 그리고 네 집안에서는 아무도 늙도록 살지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 나머지 이스라엘에는 좋은 일이 있는데도, 너는 내 집에 고난이 닥치는 것을 보게 될 것이다. 그리고 네 집안에서는 아무도 늙을 때까지 살지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will see distress in my dwelling: the meaning is uncertain
alternatives: you will look on a rival in my dwelling
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard. It reads "distress of dwelling", most likely trouble at God's dwelling, the sanctuary at Shiloh: the ark would be captured and Shiloh ruined (4:10-22; Jeremiah 7:12-14; Psalm 78:60-61). The first word can also mean "rival", giving "you will look on a rival in my dwelling", another priest in the place of Eli's house. The ancient Greek translation and a Dead Sea Scroll lack most of this verse. Reviewers should check this note against the textual evidence.

decisions.choice: in all the good that will be done for Israel: while things go well for Israel
decisions.reason: The verb is "he will do good", with no named subject; it is God who does good to Israel. Eli's house suffers even while Israel as a whole is blessed.

decisions.choice: you: Eli's house through the years
decisions.reason: "You" is Eli, standing for his family; most of what is foretold came after his death.

decisions.choice: my dwelling (Literal in brackets, Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "dwelling". All three levels supply "my", since God is speaking of his own sanctuary, as in verse 29.

source.text: וְאִ֗ישׁ לֹֽא־אַכְרִ֤ית לְךָ֙ מֵעִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔י לְכַלּ֥וֹת אֶת־עֵינֶ֖יךָ וְלַאֲדִ֣יב אֶת־נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְכָל־מַרְבִּ֥ית בֵּיתְךָ֖ יָמ֥וּתוּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man not I will cut off of yours from with my altar, to make fail your eyes and to grieve your soul; and all [the] increase of your house will die [as] men.

en.L: Yet one man of yours I will not cut off from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, to make your eyes fail and to grieve your soul; and all the increase of your house will die [as] men.
en.B: Yet one of your descendants I will not cut off from serving at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, so that your eyes will fail with weeping and your heart will grieve. All the rest of your descendants will die in the prime of life.
en.R: I will let one man from your family go on serving at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar. But his life will bring you tears and sorrow. All the rest of your family will die before they grow old.

es.L: Pero a un hombre de los tuyos no cortaré de junto a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, para consumir tus ojos y entristecer tu alma; y toda la descendencia de tu casa morirá [como] hombres.
es.B: Sin embargo, a uno de tus descendientes no lo apartaré del servicio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, para que tus ojos se consuman de llanto y tu corazón se aflija. Todos los demás descendientes tuyos morirán en la flor de la vida.
es.R: Dejaré que un hombre de tu familia siga sirviendo en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar. Pero su vida te traerá lágrimas y tristeza. Todos los demás de tu familia morirán antes de llegar a viejos.

fr.L: Pourtant, je ne retrancherai pas de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel tout homme des tiens, pour faire défaillir tes yeux et affliger ton âme ; et tous les descendants de ta maison mourront [à l’âge] d’homme.
fr.B: Pourtant, je ne retrancherai pas de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel un de tes descendants, de sorte que tes yeux se consumeront de larmes et que ton cœur sera dans la peine. Tous les autres descendants de ta famille mourront dans la force de l’âge.
fr.R: Je laisserai un homme de ta famille continuer à servir à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel. Mais sa vie te causera des larmes et du chagrin. Tous les autres membres de ta famille mourront avant d’être vieux.

sw.L: Lakini mtu mmoja wako sitamkatilia mbali na madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili kuyafifiza macho yako na kuihuzunisha nafsi yako; na wote watakaoongezeka katika nyumba yako watakufa [wakiwa] watu wazima.
sw.B: Hata hivyo mmoja wa wazao wako sitamkatilia mbali asihudumu katika madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili macho yako yafifie kwa kulia na moyo wako uhuzunike. Wazao wako wengine wote watakufa wakiwa katika ujana wao.
sw.R: Nitamwacha mtu mmoja wa jamaa yako aendelee kuhudumu katika madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Lakini maisha yake yatakuletea machozi na huzuni. Wengine wote wa jamaa yako watakufa kabla hawajazeeka.

vi.L: Nhưng một người của ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không loại khỏi bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để làm cho mắt ngươi hao mòn và linh hồn ngươi đau buồn; còn mọi kẻ sinh ra trong nhà ngươi sẽ chết [khi đang là] người trưởng thành.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không loại hết dòng dõi ngươi khỏi việc phục vụ tại bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; một người sẽ còn lại, để mắt ngươi mòn mỏi vì khóc lóc và lòng ngươi đau buồn. Những người còn lại trong dòng dõi ngươi đều sẽ chết khi đang tuổi tráng niên.
vi.R: Ta sẽ để một người trong gia đình ngươi tiếp tục phục vụ tại bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng đời người ấy sẽ đem lại cho ngươi nước mắt và buồn rầu. Tất cả những người còn lại trong gia đình ngươi sẽ chết trước khi về già.

ko.L: 그러나 네게 속한 한 사람을 내가 내 제단에서 끊지 않으리니, 이는 네 눈을 쇠하게 하고 네 영혼을 슬프게 하려는 것이다. 그리고 네 집안에서 늘어난 모든 자는 [한창 나이의] 사람으로 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 그래도 네 자손 가운데 하나는 내가 내 제단에서 섬기지 못하게 끊지 않겠다. 그러나 그 때문에 네 눈이 눈물로 흐려지고 네 마음이 슬픔에 잠길 것이다. 네 나머지 자손은 모두 한창 나이에 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 네 집안에서 한 사람은 내 제단에서 계속 섬기게 할 것이다. 그러나 그 사람 때문에 너는 눈물과 슬픔을 맛볼 것이다. 네 집안의 나머지 사람들은 모두 늙기 전에 죽을 것이다.

decisions.choice: one man I will not cut off: a single survivor left to serve
alternatives: any man of yours whom I do not cut off
decisions.reason: One of Eli's line will be spared to go on serving at the altar. This came true in Abiathar, who alone escaped the slaughter at Nob (22:20-23) and was later removed from the priesthood by Solomon (1 Kings 2:26-27).

decisions.choice: to make your eyes fail and to grieve your soul: to bring weeping and grief
decisions.reason: Eyes "fail" from weeping until they can weep no more. Even the survivor's life will be a sorrow to Eli's house.

decisions.choice: will die as men: in the prime of life
alternatives: will die by the sword of men
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says they will die "as men", grown men, not old men (verse 31). The ancient Greek translation and a Dead Sea Scroll read "by the sword of men". Reviewers should check this note against the textual evidence.

decisions.choice: the rest of your descendants (Balanced); the rest of your family (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The increase of your house" means its offspring. Balanced and Readable add "the rest" to set them apart from the one survivor.

source.text: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֣ הָא֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֔יךָ אֶל־חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָ֑ס בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד יָמ֥וּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And this to you [is] the sign which will come to [the] two of your sons, to Hophni and Phinehas: on day one will die both of them.

en.L: And this [will be] the sign to you, which will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: on one day the two of them will die.
en.B: What happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be the sign to you: both of them will die on the same day.
en.R: This is how you will know that what I say will come true: your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will both die on the same day.

es.L: Y esta [será] para ti la señal, lo que vendrá sobre tus dos hijos, sobre Ofni y Finés: en un mismo día morirán los dos.
es.B: Lo que les ocurra a tus dos hijos, Ofni y Finés, te servirá de señal: los dos morirán el mismo día.
es.R: Así sabrás que lo que digo se cumplirá: tus dos hijos, Ofni y Finés, morirán los dos el mismo día.

fr.L: Et voici le signe pour toi, ce qui arrivera à tes deux fils, à Hophni et Phinéas : en un seul jour ils mourront tous les deux.
fr.B: Ce qui arrivera à tes deux fils, Hophni et Phinéas, sera pour toi le signe : ils mourront tous les deux le même jour.
fr.R: Voici comment tu sauras que ce que je dis va se réaliser : tes deux fils, Hophni et Phinéas, mourront tous les deux le même jour.

sw.L: Na hii [itakuwa] ishara kwako, itakayowajia wana wako wawili, Hofni na Finehasi: siku moja watakufa wote wawili.
sw.B: Kitakachowapata wana wako wawili, Hofni na Finehasi, kitakuwa ishara kwako: wote wawili watakufa siku moja.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo utakavyojua kwamba ninayosema yatatimia: wana wako wawili, Hofni na Finehasi, watakufa wote siku moja.

vi.L: Đây [sẽ là] dấu hiệu cho ngươi, là điều sẽ xảy đến cho hai con trai ngươi, cho Hóp-ni và Phi-nê-a: trong một ngày cả hai sẽ chết.
vi.B: Điều sẽ xảy đến cho hai con trai ngươi là Hóp-ni và Phi-nê-a sẽ là dấu hiệu cho ngươi: cả hai sẽ chết cùng một ngày.
vi.R: Đây là cách ngươi sẽ biết lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phán sẽ thành sự thật: hai con trai ngươi là Hóp-ni và Phi-nê-a sẽ cùng chết trong một ngày.

ko.L: 그리고 네 두 아들 홉니와 비느하스에게 닥칠 일이 네게 표징이 될 것이니, 한날에 그 둘이 다 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 네 두 아들 홉니와 비느하스에게 일어날 일이 너에게 표징이 될 것이다. 그 둘이 한날에 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 내 말이 이루어질 것을 너는 이렇게 알게 될 것이다. 네 두 아들 홉니와 비느하스가 같은 날에 죽을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the sign: a near event that proves the longer word true
decisions.reason: Eli will live to hear of his sons' deaths, and that will show that the rest of the message will also come true. Both die in one day in battle with the Philistines (4:11, 17).

decisions.choice: This is how you will know that what I say will come true (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the sign is for.

source.text: וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י לִי֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן נֶאֱמָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּלְבָבִ֥י וּבְנַפְשִׁ֖י יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּבָנִ֤יתִי לוֹ֙ בַּ֣יִת נֶאֱמָ֔ן וְהִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְלִפְנֵֽי־מְשִׁיחִ֖י כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will raise up for myself a priest faithful; according to what [is] in my heart and in my soul he will do; and I will build for him a house sure, and he will walk before my anointed all the days.

en.L: And I will raise up for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} a faithful priest; he will do according to what [is] in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart and in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul. And I will build for him a sure house, and he will walk before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed all the days.
en.B: I will raise up for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} a faithful priest, who will do what is in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart and mind. I will build him a lasting house, and he will walk before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed for all time.
en.R: I will choose a priest for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} who will be faithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. He will do everything I want him to do. I will give him a family line that will last, and he will always serve the king I have anointed.

es.L: Y levantaré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un sacerdote fiel; él hará conforme a lo que [hay] en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma. Y le edificaré una casa firme, y andará delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ungido todos los días.
es.B: Levantaré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un sacerdote fiel, que hará lo que hay en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mente. Le edificaré una casa duradera, y andará delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ungido para siempre.
es.R: Escogeré para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un sacerdote que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sea fiel. Él hará todo lo que yo quiero. Le daré una descendencia que perdurará, y siempre servirá al rey que yo he ungido.

fr.L: Et je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} susciterai un prêtre fidèle ; il agira selon ce qui [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur et dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme. Et je lui bâtirai une maison sûre, et il marchera devant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} oint tous les jours.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} susciterai un prêtre fidèle, qui fera ce qui est dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur et dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} pensée. Je lui bâtirai une maison stable, et il marchera devant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} oint pour toujours.
fr.R: Je choisirai pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un prêtre qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sera fidèle. Il fera tout ce que je veux qu’il fasse. Je lui donnerai une famille qui durera, et il servira toujours le roi que j’ai oint.

sw.L: Nami nitajiinulia kuhani mwaminifu; atatenda kulingana na [yaliyo] moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}} na nafsini {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}. Nami nitamjengea nyumba imara, naye atatembea mbele ya masihi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} siku zote.
sw.B: Nitajiinulia kuhani mwaminifu, atakayetenda yaliyo moyoni na akilini {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}. Nitamjengea nyumba ya kudumu, naye atatembea mbele ya mpakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} siku zote.
sw.R: Nitajichagulia kuhani atakayekuwa mwaminifu kwangu. Atafanya kila kitu ninachotaka afanye. Nitampa ukoo utakaodumu, naye atamtumikia daima mfalme niliyempaka mafuta.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập lên cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một thầy tế lễ trung tín; người sẽ làm theo điều [ở] trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trong linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ xây cho người một nhà vững bền, và người sẽ bước đi trước mặt người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mọi ngày.
vi.B: Ta sẽ lập cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một thầy tế lễ trung tín, là người sẽ làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn trong lòng và trong trí. Ta sẽ xây cho người một nhà bền lâu, và người sẽ bước đi trước mặt người được {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xức dầu mãi mãi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ chọn cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một thầy tế lễ trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người ấy sẽ làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn. Ta sẽ ban cho người một dòng dõi lâu bền, và người sẽ luôn phục vụ vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xức dầu.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 나를 위해 신실한 제사장을 세우리니, 그가 내 마음과 내 영혼에 있는 대로 행할 것이다. 그리고 내가 그를 위해 견고한 집을 세우리니, 그가 언제까지나 내 기름 부음 받은 이 앞에서 다닐 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 나를 위해 신실한 제사장을 세우겠다. 그는 내 마음과 뜻대로 행할 것이다. 내가 그에게 든든한 집안을 세워 주겠고, 그는 언제까지나 내가 기름 부은 이 앞에서 섬길 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 나에게 충실한 제사장을 뽑아 세울 것이다. 그는 내가 원하는 일을 다 할 것이다. 내가 그의 집안을 오래도록 이어지게 하겠다. 그리고 그는 내가 기름 부어 세운 왕을 언제나 섬길 것이다.

decisions.choice: a faithful priest: who is meant
decisions.reason: In the story that follows, Samuel fills this role first: the LORD is with him, all Israel knows he is faithful (3:19-20), and he offers sacrifices for the people (7:9). But a priest with a lasting house who serves before the king points most fully to Zadok, who replaced Abiathar of Eli's line under Solomon; 1 Kings 2:27 and 2:35 say this fulfilled the word spoken at Shiloh.

decisions.choice: faithful priest, sure house: the same word twice
decisions.reason: The word ne'eman means faithful, firm, reliable. The priest will be faithful, and so God will make his house firm and lasting. God makes the same promise of a sure house to David (2 Samuel 7:16; compare 1 Samuel 25:28).

decisions.choice: my anointed: the king God will appoint
decisions.reason: As in Hannah's song (verse 10), the prophecy looks ahead to a king Israel does not yet have. The priest will serve in the presence of the LORD's anointed king.

decisions.choice: in my heart and in my soul: in my mind and my will
decisions.reason: Heart and soul together mean what God thinks and desires. The faithful priest will act as God wants.

decisions.choice: a sure house (Literal); a lasting house (Balanced); a family line that will last (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sure", the same word as "faithful". Balanced says "lasting". Readable says what "house" means here: a line of descendants.

decisions.choice: the king I have anointed (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, Readable says who "my anointed" is.

decisions.choice: kuhani mwaminifu ... nyumba imara (L); nyumba ya kudumu (B); ukoo utakaodumu (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one word for the faithful priest and the sure house (m2); Swahili cannot use "mwaminifu" of a house, so it says "imara" and "ya kudumu", and the meaning decision keeps the link.

decisions.choice: "내가 기름 부은 이" (B)
decisions.reason: God speaks of his own act, so the honorific of the terms-note phrase "주께서 기름 부으신 이" drops in his mouth; Readable keeps the terms-note "기름 부어 세운 왕" in the same way.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כָּל־הַנּוֹתָר֙ בְּבֵ֣יתְךָ֔ יָבוֹא֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת ל֔וֹ לַאֲג֥וֹרַת כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּר־לָ֑חֶם וְאָמַ֗ר סְפָחֵ֥נִי נָ֛א אֶל־אַחַ֥ת הַכְּהֻנּ֖וֹת לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פַּת־לָֽחֶם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, everyone who is left in your house will come to bow down to him for a payment of silver and a loaf of bread, and say, attach me, please, to one of the priesthoods, to eat a piece of bread.

en.L: And it will be [that] everyone who is left in your house will come to bow down to him for a payment of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, "Please attach me to one of the priestly offices, that I may eat a piece of bread."'"
en.B: Then everyone left in your family will come and bow down to him for a little silver and a loaf of bread, and say, "Please put me in one of the priestly posts so that I can have a scrap of bread to eat."'"
en.R: Anyone left in your family will come and bow down to him. They will beg for a little money and a piece of bread. They will say, "Please give me some kind of priestly job, so that I will have something to eat."'"

es.L: Y sucederá [que] todo el que quede en tu casa vendrá a postrarse ante él por una moneda de plata y una hogaza de pan, y dirá: ‘Te ruego que me agregues a uno de los oficios sacerdotales, para que coma un bocado de pan’”».
es.B: Entonces todo el que quede de tu familia vendrá a postrarse ante él por un poco de plata y una hogaza de pan, y le dirá: ‘Por favor, ponme en alguno de los cargos sacerdotales para que tenga un pedazo de pan que comer’”».
es.R: Cualquiera que quede de tu familia vendrá a inclinarse ante él. Le rogará que le dé un poco de dinero y un pedazo de pan. Le dirá: ‘Por favor, dame algún trabajo de sacerdote, para que tenga algo que comer’”».

fr.L: Et il arrivera que quiconque restera dans ta maison viendra se prosterner devant lui pour une pièce d’argent et une miche de pain, et dira : ‘Attache-moi, je te prie, à l’une des fonctions de prêtre, pour que je mange un morceau de pain.’” »
fr.B: Alors tous ceux qui resteront de ta famille viendront se prosterner devant lui pour un peu d’argent et une miche de pain, en disant : ‘Je t’en prie, donne-moi une place parmi les prêtres, pour que j’aie un morceau de pain à manger.’” »
fr.R: Tous ceux qui resteront dans ta famille viendront se prosterner devant lui. Ils mendieront un peu d’argent et un morceau de pain. Ils diront : ‘S’il te plaît, donne-moi un travail de prêtre, pour que j’aie quelque chose à manger.’” »

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] kila mtu atakayebaki katika nyumba yako atakuja kumsujudia kwa ajili ya kipande cha fedha na mkate mmoja, na atasema, "Tafadhali niweke katika mojawapo ya kazi za ukuhani, nipate kula kipande cha mkate."'"
sw.B: Kisha kila mtu atakayebaki katika jamaa yako atakuja kumsujudia ili apate fedha kidogo na mkate mmoja, na kusema, "Tafadhali nipe nafasi katika mojawapo ya kazi za ukuhani ili nipate kipande cha mkate cha kula."'"
sw.R: Yeyote atakayebaki katika jamaa yako atakuja kumsujudia. Watamwomba pesa kidogo na kipande cha mkate. Watasema, "Tafadhali nipe kazi yoyote ya kikuhani, ili nipate kitu cha kula."'"

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra là hễ ai còn sót lại trong nhà ngươi sẽ đến quỳ lạy người ấy để xin một đồng bạc và một ổ bánh, và sẽ nói: "Xin cho tôi được gia nhập vào một trong các chức tế lễ, để tôi được ăn một miếng bánh."'"
vi.B: Rồi mọi người còn lại trong gia đình ngươi sẽ đến quỳ lạy người ấy để xin một ít bạc và một ổ bánh, và nói: "Xin cho tôi được làm một chức vụ tế lễ nào đó để tôi có miếng bánh mà ăn."'"
vi.R: Bất cứ ai còn lại trong gia đình ngươi sẽ đến quỳ lạy người ấy. Họ sẽ xin một ít tiền và một mẩu bánh. Họ sẽ nói: "Xin cho tôi một công việc nào đó trong chức tế lễ, để tôi có cái mà ăn."'"

ko.L: 그리고 네 집에 남은 자는 누구나 은 한 닢과 빵 한 덩이를 얻으려고 와서 그에게 절하며 '부디 나를 제사장 직분 가운데 하나에 붙여 주셔서 빵 한 조각이라도 먹게 해 주십시오' 하고 말할 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그때 네 집안에 남은 자는 누구나 은 몇 푼과 빵 한 덩이를 얻으려고 그에게 와서 절하며, '제발 저를 제사장 자리 하나에 넣어 주셔서, 빵 부스러기라도 먹게 해 주십시오' 하고 말할 것이다.'"
ko.R: 네 집안에 남은 사람은 누구든지 그에게 와서 절할 것이다. 그들은 돈 몇 푼과 빵 한 조각을 구걸할 것이다. 그들은 '제발 제사장 일 가운데 무엇이든 하게 해 주십시오. 그래야 먹을 것이라도 얻겠습니다' 하고 말할 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: a payment of silver: a small coin or wage
decisions.reason: The noun is found only here. It seems to mean a small payment, a coin or a day's pay.

decisions.choice: the priestly offices: duties at the sanctuary that came with a share of the offerings
decisions.reason: Priests lived from their part of what was offered (Deuteronomy 18:1-8). A lesser post would still give food. Compare the priests of the high places in 2 Kings 23:9, who ate bread among their brothers but did not serve at the altar.

decisions.choice: a piece of bread: the house that took by force will beg
decisions.reason: Eli's sons seized the best meat from the worshipers (verses 13-16). Their descendants will beg for a scrap of bread.

decisions.choice: the quotation marks close here: the double quote of the beggar's words, the single quote of the LORD's words, and the double quote of the man of God's speech
decisions.reason: The man of God's message, which began in verse 27, ends with this verse.
